title: Sales and Marketing Intern
description:
**Business Executive Intern**

Job Type

* Internship (Full\-Time)
* Work Mode: On\-site
* Duration: 3–6 Months

**About the Internship**

Vibrantick Infotech Solutions is looking for energetic, confident, and motivated **Business Executive Interns** who are interested in business development, sales, client relationship management, and market research. This internship provides practical exposure to the complete sales cycle, from lead generation to client onboarding.

**Roles \& ResponsibilitiesBusiness Development**

* Identify and generate new business opportunities through online platforms, referrals, and market research.
* Research potential clients and target industries.
* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline.
* Support the sales team in achieving business targets.

**Lead Generation**

* Generate leads through LinkedIn, email campaigns, social media, and online directories.
* Qualify leads based on business requirements.
* Maintain and update lead databases in CRM or spreadsheets.
* Follow up with prospective clients.

**Client Communication**

* Contact prospective clients through phone calls, emails, WhatsApp, and virtual meetings.
* Understand client requirements and recommend suitable solutions.
* Schedule meetings and product demonstrations.
* Maintain professional communication throughout the sales process.

**Proposal \& Documentation**

* Assist in preparing quotations, proposals, and presentations.
* Support documentation for client onboarding.
* Coordinate with internal teams for project discussions and follow\-ups.
* Maintain records of client interactions and business activities.

**Market Research**

* Analyze industry trends and competitor activities.
* Identify new business opportunities and market segments.
* Collect customer feedback and suggest business improvements.

**Sales Support**

* Assist in preparing daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports.
* Update CRM with client information and sales progress.
* Track sales activities and follow up on pending opportunities.
* Support customer relationship management initiatives.

**Collaboration**

* Coordinate with the Digital Marketing, Development, and Design teams to ensure smooth project execution.
* Participate in team meetings and contribute ideas for business growth.

**Required Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills.
* Confidence in speaking with clients.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Ability to work in a target\-oriented environment.
* Good organizational and time management skills.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

**Preferred Skills**

* Basic knowledge of sales, marketing, or business development.
* Familiarity with CRM tools is an advantage.
* Knowledge of LinkedIn Sales Navigator or lead generation tools is a plus.
* Basic understanding of digital marketing or IT services is beneficial.

**Eligibility**

* Final\-year students or recent graduates.
* BBA, MBA (Marketing/Sales), B.Com, M.Com, BA, BCA, B.Tech, or graduates from any discipline interested in business development.
* Freshers are encouraged to apply.

**What You'll Learn**

* Business Development strategies.
* Lead Generation techniques.
* Client Communication and Relationship Management.
* Sales Pipeline Management.
* Proposal and Presentation Preparation.
* CRM and Sales Reporting.
* Negotiation and Closing Skills.
* B2B Sales Process.
* Corporate Communication and Professional Etiquette.

**Perks \& Benefits**

* Internship Completion Certificate.
* Letter of Recommendation for outstanding performers.
* Hands\-on experience with real client interactions.
* Mentorship from experienced business professionals.
* Opportunity for a full\-time Business Executive role based on performance.
* Professional and collaborative work environment.

**Working Hours**

* Monday to Friday
* 10:00 AM – 6:30 PM

**How to Apply**

Send your updated resume to the HR Team or apply through our careers page. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

title: Software Testing Intern
description:
**Software Testing Intern**

**Company:** Vibrantick Infotech Solutions  
**Location:** 36, Second Floor, Office, D\-185, Phase 8B, Industrial Area, Sector 74, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab – 160055  
**Website:** https://vibrantick.in

Job Type

* Internship (Full\-Time)
* Work Mode: On\-site
* Duration: 3–6 Months

**About the Internship**

Vibrantick Infotech Solutions is looking for detail\-oriented and enthusiastic **Software Testing Interns** who are passionate about ensuring software quality. This internship offers hands\-on experience in testing web applications, mobile applications, ERP/CRM systems, and other software products while working alongside experienced developers and QA professionals.

**Roles \& ResponsibilitiesManual Testing**

* Understand project requirements and software specifications.
* Create and execute test cases and test scenarios.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, smoke, and sanity testing.
* Verify bug fixes and ensure software quality before release.
* Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) support.

**Bug Reporting \& Tracking**

* Identify, reproduce, and document software defects.
* Report bugs with detailed steps, screenshots, and expected vs. actual results.
* Track issues using bug\-tracking tools.
* Coordinate with developers to resolve reported issues.
* Retest resolved defects and validate fixes.

**Web \& Mobile Application Testing**

* Test websites across different browsers and devices.
* Perform responsive design testing.
* Test Android and iOS applications.
* Verify forms, payment gateways, login modules, APIs, and user workflows.

**Database \& API Testing**

* Perform basic database validation using SQL queries.
* Test REST APIs using tools like Postman.
* Validate request and response data.
* Verify API functionality and error handling.

**Performance \& Security Basics**

* Assist in basic performance and load testing.
* Verify application security features such as authentication and authorization.
* Identify usability and performance issues.

**Documentation**

* Prepare test plans, test cases, and test reports.
* Maintain testing documentation for each release.
* Document defects and testing results accurately.

**Collaboration**

* Work closely with developers, project managers, and designers.
* Participate in daily stand\-up meetings and project discussions.
* Contribute ideas to improve software quality and testing processes.

**Required Skills**

* Basic understanding of Software Testing concepts.
* Knowledge of SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) and STLC (Software Testing Life Cycle).
* Understanding of manual testing techniques.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Attention to detail and a quality\-focused mindset.
* Ability to work independently and in a team.

**Preferred Skills**

* Basic knowledge of SQL.
* Familiarity with Postman or other API testing tools.
* Understanding of bug tracking tools such as Jira, Trello, or Bugzilla.
* Basic knowledge of automation testing tools (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or any programming language is a plus.

**Eligibility**

* Final\-year students or recent graduates.
* B.Tech, BCA, MCA, M.Tech, Diploma (Computer Science/IT), or any graduate interested in Software Testing.
* Freshers are encouraged to apply.

**What You'll Learn**

* Manual Testing techniques.
* Test Case Design and Execution.
* Bug Reporting and Defect Management.
* API Testing using Postman.
* Database Testing with SQL.
* Cross\-browser and Mobile Testing.
* QA Documentation Standards.
* Agile Testing Methodologies.
* Basics of Automation Testing.
* Real\-time software testing on live client projects.

**Perks \& Benefits**

* Internship Completion Certificate.
* Letter of Recommendation for outstanding performers.
* Hands\-on experience with live projects.
* Guidance from experienced QA professionals.
* Opportunity for a full\-time Software Tester position based on performance.
* Professional and collaborative work environment.

**Working Hours**

* Monday to Friday
* 10:00 AM – 6:30 PM

**How to Apply**

Send your updated resume to the HR Team or apply through our careers page. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

* Liaising with People \& Safety Managers for queries and issues relating to colleagues' pay.
* Understanding and applying UK legislation, Tesco policies, DC\-specific terms \& conditions, and payroll systems and procedures


appropriately to ensure compliance with HR and payroll policies, procedures, and regulations.  

* Specializing in activities/tasks like new starters, ROTA changes, retrospective corrections, leavers, transfers, etc.

**You will need**  


 Good communication skills

\- MS Office \- Excel, Word \& Powerpoint  

Admin transactional based environment.  

* Eye\-to\-Detail
* Exposure of working in UK Payroll environment is desirable.
* Speed and Accuracy
* Planning and Organising
* Good Numeracy skills
* Analytical mindset

**Whats in it for you?**  


At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you.

As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market\- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day.

Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars \- Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.

Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles \- simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable.

**Salary** \- Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment.

**Performance Bonus** \- Opportunity to earn additional compensation bonus based on performance, paid annually

**Leave \& Time\-off** \- Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy.

**Making Retirement Tension\-FreeSalary** \- In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF.

**Health is Wealth** \- Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in\-laws.

**Mental Wellbeing** \- We offer mental health support through self\-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face\-to\-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.

**Financial Wellbeing** \- Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one\-to\-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** \- Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3\-year savings plan.

**Physical Wellbeing** \- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle.
**About Us**  


At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve.

 At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed.

 We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

**About the Project**

Surya Group of Hotels and Resorts is developing a landmark luxury eco\-resort near Satkosia Tiger Reserve, Angul, Odisha. This is one of Eastern India's most ambitious hospitality construction projects and we are building a strong site team to match the scale of it.

We are hiring a Site Engineer who will work directly under the Project Manager and own day\-to\-day execution on the ground.

This is a hands\-on execution role. **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience on hotel, resort, or premium commercial projects

**What Working Here Looks Like**

You will be part of a lean, serious site team working on a project that most engineers in Odisha will talk about for years. The site is near Satkosia Tiger Reserve. The finish standards are luxury hospitality. The pace is demanding and the expectations are high.

If you deliver here, Surya Group has a second resort at Deomali already in planning. The team that builds Satkosia builds that one too.

title: Industrial Safety Officer
description:
**Job Purpose**

To ensure a safe, healthy, and compliant working environment by implementing and monitoring Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS) systems, reducing accidents, ensuring statutory compliance, and building a strong safety culture across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Safety Management**

* Implement and enforce safety policies, procedures, and standard operating practices.
* Conduct daily safety inspections of shop floor, machines, material handling, and work areas.
* Ensure machine guarding, PPE usage, lock\-out/tag\-out (LOTO), and safe work practices are followed.
* Identify unsafe acts and unsafe conditions and take immediate corrective action.
* Lead accident prevention programs and safety campaigns.

**2\. Accident \& Incident Management**

* Investigate all accidents, near misses, and dangerous occurrences.
* Prepare accident investigation reports with root cause analysis and corrective action plans.
* Coordinate with HR, Production, and Legal teams in case of serious accidents.
* Maintain accident and incident records as per statutory requirements.

**3\. Statutory \& Legal Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with:
* Factories Act
* State Safety Rules
* ESI, Workmen Compensation
* Fire \& Emergency regulations
* Maintain all statutory registers, safety records, and inspection reports.
* Coordinate with Factory Inspector, Fire Department, and other authorities.

**4\. Safety Training \& Awareness**

* Conduct safety induction for new employees, contract workers, and visitors.
* Organize periodic safety training programs for operators, supervisors, and managers.
* Conduct tool box talks and safety briefings.
* Create awareness on machine safety, electrical safety, fire safety, and emergency response.

**5\. EHS Systems \& Audits**

* Develop and maintain EHS management systems and SOPs.
* Conduct internal safety audits and risk assessments.
* Support ISO 45001 / ISO 14001 audits (if applicable).
* Monitor compliance of contractors and vendors with safety standards.

**6\. Fire \& Emergency Preparedness**

* Maintain fire fighting equipment, emergency exits, and evacuation plans.
* Conduct mock drills and emergency response training.
* Act as key coordinator during any emergency.

**7\. Environment Management**

* Monitor waste disposal, hazardous material handling, and pollution control.
* Ensure compliance with environmental regulations.
* Coordinate with Pollution Control Board and waste management vendors.

**Key Skills Required**

* Strong knowledge of industrial safety rules and laws
* Accident investigation and root cause analysis
* Safety audit and inspection skills
* Training \& communication
* Documentation \& compliance management
* Ability to enforce discipline tactfully

**Qualification \& Experience**

* Diploma / Degree in Safety Engineering, Industrial Safety, or Environmental Engineering
* Mandatory: NEBOSH / ADIS / DIS or equivalent certification
* 3 \- 8 years’ experience in manufacturing / heavy engineering / industrial plants.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

description:

The ideal candidate will be responsible for recruiting, coordinating, and managing event staff while ensuring smooth communication, compliance, and workforce efficiency before, during, and after events.

**Key Responsibilities \- Recruitment \& Staffing** 

* Recruit and onboard event staff, promoters, hosts, volunteers, coordinators, and temporary workers.

**Employee Management**

**Training \& Development**

title: Legal Officer
description:
**Job Description (JD)** 

**Position:** Legal Officer

**Department:** Legal \& Compliance  
**Reports To:** Chief Legal Officer / General Manager / Managing Director  
**Location:** As per Company Requirement  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Job Summary**

The Legal Officer is responsible for handling all legal matters of the organization, ensuring statutory compliance, minimizing legal risks, drafting and reviewing legal documents, coordinating litigation, and providing legal guidance to the management. The role also ensures compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Legal Documentation**

* Draft, review, vet, and negotiate contracts, agreements, MOUs, NDAs, service agreements, vendor agreements, employment agreements, lease agreements, and other legal documents.
* Ensure all agreements adequately safeguard the Company's legal interests.
* Maintain a centralized repository of all legal documents and contracts.

**2\. Litigation Management**

* Coordinate with external advocates and legal consultants.
* Prepare case files, legal briefs, and supporting documentation.
* Track the progress of ongoing litigation and ensure timely follow\-up.
* Attend court proceedings, arbitration, and legal hearings whenever required.

**3\. Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable Central and State laws.
* Monitor changes in legal and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate legal compliance with Government Departments and Regulatory Authorities.
* Maintain statutory registers and legal compliance records.

**4\. Corporate Legal Advisory**

* Provide legal opinions to Management on business decisions.
* Identify legal risks associated with business operations.
* Recommend preventive legal measures to minimize litigation.

**5\. HR \& Employment Laws**

* Advise HR on labor laws and employment\-related matters.
* Draft appointment letters, employment contracts, service agreements, indemnity bonds, confidentiality agreements, disciplinary notices, warning letters, show\-cause notices, suspension orders, termination letters, and settlement agreements.
* Handle employee disputes and labor\-related legal issues.

**6\. Intellectual Property Rights**

* Coordinate registration of trademarks, copyrights, patents, and domain names.
* Protect the Company's intellectual property rights.
* Monitor misuse or infringement of Company IP.

**7\. Compliance \& Risk Management**

* Conduct legal compliance audits.
* Develop legal compliance checklists.
* Maintain legal risk registers.
* Support internal and statutory audits.

**8\. Policy Development**

* Draft and review Company policies, SOPs, and governance documents.
* Ensure policies comply with prevailing legal requirements.
* Assist departments in implementing legal controls.

**9\. Notices \& Legal Correspondence**

* Draft legal notices, replies, affidavits, petitions, representations, and legal communications.
* Respond to Government notices and legal queries.
* Liaise with Government authorities when required.

**10\. Corporate Governance**

* Assist in Board Meeting documentation, resolutions, and legal records.
* Support corporate filings and secretarial compliance as applicable.
* Maintain confidentiality of all legal matters.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Law (LL.B.) – Mandatory
* Master's Degree (LL.M.) – Preferred
* Enrollment with the Bar Council will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* 3–7 years of experience in Corporate Legal, Litigation, or Legal Compliance.
* Experience in IT, Software Development, Education, E\-commerce, or Corporate organizations is preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Contract Law, Labour Laws, Company Law, and Commercial Laws.
* Familiarity with the Information Technology Act, 2000, Intellectual Property Laws, and Data Privacy regulations.
* Knowledge of POSH Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, Industrial Relations Code, Code on Wages, Social Security Code, and Occupational Safety, Health \& Working Conditions Code.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and legal documentation software.
* Ability to conduct legal research and interpret statutes.

**Core Competencies**

* Excellent drafting and documentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
* High level of integrity and confidentiality.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple assignments.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely review and execution of legal documents.
* Compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Reduction in legal risks and disputes.
* Timely resolution of litigation matters.
* Accuracy and quality of legal opinions.
* Contract turnaround time.
* Zero non\-compliance observations during audits.
* Timely renewal of licenses, registrations, and statutory filings.
* Effective legal support to business and HR functions.

**Working Relationships**

**Internal:**

* Managing Director
* Chief Technical Officer
* HR Department
* Finance \& Accounts
* Administration
* Business Development
* Operations
* Audit Team

**External:**

* Advocates and Legal Consultants
* Courts and Tribunals
* Government Departments
* Regulatory Authorities
* Police Authorities
* Vendors and Clients

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Safeguard the Company's legal interests and reputation.
* Maintain complete confidentiality of legal and business information.
* Support internal investigations and disciplinary proceedings.
* Conduct legal awareness and compliance training for employees.
* Assist Management in strategic legal planning and risk mitigation.
* Perform any other legal assignments entrusted by the Management from time to time.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

title: Manager, Implementation - IT Product
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

  

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Rippling’s Product Specialist team ensures customers see incredible business transformation through Rippling's most complex products.

  

Our engagements are consultative. Our specialists deeply understand the customers’ unique pain points, offer creative solutions, and build/set up their Rippling environment to address their needs. Hence, our specialists serve as a bridge between the customer and product teams. They are instrumental in driving adoption.

  

This role is to manage a new team of IT Specialists to drive exponential impact of LTV and adoption.

  

The ideal candidate for this role has experience leading teams, building processes and systems, driving operational rigor, implementing IT products (specifically\- Apps, MDM, Okta, Azure), and working with cross\-functional stakeholders. They must also handle ambiguity, unstructured situations, and scale while leading a team with high standards.

**What you will do**
--------------------

  

* Mentor, hire, and lead a team of product specialists.
* Drive an implementation team to successfully meet KPIs: productivity, project completions, adoption thresholds, and CSAT.
* + Continuously measure the effectiveness and quality of our IT implementations and make process improvements
* Work cross\-functionally with sales, CX, and product managers to improve adoption, retention, and LTV.
* This role requires a strong understanding of the below:
* + **MDM, Identity Management solutions, or other IT\-related solutions. Familiarity with other IT products such as Google, Azure, and Okta.**
* Lead trainings for internal and external resources to increase the overall knowledge of Rippling’s IT products
* Actively contribute to the development of Rippling’s IT Products through collaboration with sales, product and engineering
* + Regularly coordinate with product and engineering teams to fix bugs and launch new features
	+ Serve as a connector between engineering, product, and other customer\-facing teams
* Organize beta programs and support GTM efforts for IT product launches

**What you will need**
----------------------

  

* 6\+ years of experience implementing IT products (prior management experience is strongly preferred)
* Strong prioritization and time management
* Self\-starter with a bias towards action, energized by a fast\-paced environment and excited to build
* Data and process\-centric leader with attention to detail and the ability to solve complex, interdependent problems
* Experience in growing teams with a learning mindset, people\-first attitude, and strong sense of responsibility for your domain
* Able to work with cross\-functional leaders to drive improvements to product and processes

**Note**
--------

* **This is a hybrid role and will require you to work out of our Bangalore office three days a week.**
* **This job requires you a t****o work in the EST shift.**

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

  

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com


Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

description:
**Junior Quality Engineer**

**Department:** Quality Assurance (QA/QC)  
**Designation:** Junior Quality Engineer  
**Industry:** Ductile Iron Pipe (DIP) Manufacturing

Job Summary

The Junior Quality Engineer is responsible for monitoring and maintaining quality standards throughout the Ductile Iron Pipe (DIP) manufacturing process. The role involves inspecting raw materials, in\-process products, and finished pipes to ensure compliance with **IS 8329, ISO 2531, EN 545, EN 598**, customer specifications, and company quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Incoming Material Inspection

* Inspect incoming raw materials, ferro alloys, cement, zinc, bitumen, and other consumables.
* Verify supplier quality certificates and test reports.
* Ensure material conformity with approved specifications.

In\-Process Quality Control

* Monitor quality parameters during:
* Melting
* Centrifugal Casting (CCM)
* Annealing
* Finishing
* Zinc Coating
* Cement Mortar Lining (CML)
* Hydrostatic Pressure Testing (HPTM)
* Conduct visual inspections to identify casting defects, cracks, blowholes, shrinkage, and surface imperfections.
* Verify socket and spigot dimensions using standard measuring instruments.

Finished Product Inspection

* Inspect finished DI pipes before dispatch.
* Verify:
* Pipe dimensions
* Wall thickness
* Length
* Socket and spigot profiles
* Zinc coating thickness
* Cement mortar lining quality
* External coating quality
* Pipe marking and traceability

Testing \& Measurement

* Perform dimensional inspection using:
* Vernier Calipers
* Micrometers
* Ultrasonic Thickness Gauges
* Measuring Tapes
* Go/No\-Go Gauges
* Assist in hydrostatic pressure testing verification.

This role will report into Sr. D\&T Manager \- Data Stewardship, GDGS team in India and functionally collaborate with stakeholders (business and technical teams) across the Enterprise teams. This individual will develop and support the data policies, processes, rules and standards for our Unstructured data (documents, emails, media files, PDFs, social media, chat logs, etc.) across the enterprise. The Unstructured Data Steward has ownership and accountability for executing data governance processes and standards for the Unstructured data.

 **KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Lead Data Governance initiatives within the Unstructured data space.
* Develop and maintain a governance framework for unstructured data including ownership, security, access, retention, lineage, and quality monitoring.
* Support configuration and roll out of new software solution for managing Unstructured data.
* Partner with data owners to classify and tag unstructured content using metadata and assisted tools.
* Establish audit methodology and remediation approach.
* Identify and inventory unstructured data sources across business units (SharePoint, network drives, email archives, Microsoft teams, etc.)
* Work across functions to classify, catalog, label and govern unstructured content, ensuring it is discoverable, secure, and used responsibly in compliance with enterprise data policies and regulatory frameworks.
* Collaborate with different functions and stakeholders (including Cyber Security, Office 365 and Governance) to drive adherence to Unstructured Data Policy and standards.
* Partner with the data cataloging team to integrate unstructured data assets into the Enterprise Data Catalog.

 **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree
* **Experience:** 10\+ years (2\+ years of relevant experience preferred).

 **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in Unstructured Data Governance
* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive change with cross functional stakeholders.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Experience and competence in leading, influencing, coaching and mentoring others

description:

**Role and Responsibilities:**


* Set the HR AI and automation strategy, translating enterprise AI direction into a clear HR roadmap linked to HR strategy, enterprise transformation, scaled automation, agentic delivery and personal productivity.
* Define and evolve the HR AI architecture in partnership with Enterprise Architecture, CDO, Digital Channels, HR Technology and control functions, ensuring solutions are coherent, governed, reusable and aligned to the wider technology landscape.
* Own the AI vendor strategy for HR, shaping how platforms such as Microsoft, Workday and ServiceNow are used as part of a joined\-up approach.
* Surface, shape and challenge vendor AI roadmaps, ensuring emerging capabilities are understood early and aligned to Barclays’ architecture, priorities and risk appetite.
* Act as a visible enterprise leader for AI in HR, building confidence and momentum by connecting strategy to tangible use cases, scaled enablement and measurable outcomes.
* Define and drive the AI adoption model across HR, separating broad colleague adoption from targeted “power user” enablement and scaling both effectively.
* Build capability across HR, improving AI literacy, confidence and practical application at all levels.
* Design and operationalise AI governance for HR, setting clear guardrails for risk, ethics, data use and controls while enabling delivery pace.
* Act as the link into enterprise AI governance, translating central standards into practical, usable guidance for HR teams.
* Bring hands\-on technical credibility, working closely with delivery teams to understand code, data, orchestration and design, and challenge decisions to avoid over\-engineered or fragmented solutions.
* Partner with the Foundry and Federated AI teams, where they lead build and run, while this role owns use case definition, AI patterns and reuse across HR.
* Bring forward new AI use cases and reusable patterns, testing, proving and scaling them across HR.
* Identify and drive reuse of AI components and patterns, reducing duplication and accelerating scale.

* Shape and assure the AI demand pipeline, challenging whether use cases solve the right problems and use the right solutions, aligned to platform capability.
* Set strategic plans and delivery objectives for the AI and automation portfolio, aligning backlog to enterprise priorities, journey outcomes, control requirements and capacity creation goals.
* Drive execution through clear operating rhythms, governance and decision points to convert ideas into live services and sustained value.

RINA is currently recruiting for a **Senior Talent Recruiter** to join its office in Mumbai within the **Global Human Resources** Division.


**Mission**
-----------


The Senior Recruiter, under the direction of and in collaboration with the local Head of Human Resources/Recruitment, is responsible for creating and delivering all facets of recruiting success throughout the organization. This will be achieved through the development of local and national recruiting plans, employing traditional sourcing strategies and resources as well as developing new, creative recruiting strategies.

  

\#LI\-KS1


**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------


1\. Strategic Planning:
  

* Contribute to the development of long\-term talent acquisition strategies in alignment with the company's business goals.
* Collaborate with senior management to understand organizational needs and create recruitment plans that support strategic objectives.

2\. Client Relationship Management:
  

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal clients, including hiring managers and department heads, to better understand their staffing needs and provide strategic recruiting solutions.

3\. Project Management and recrutment process:
  

* Lead and manage recruitment projects, ensuring they are executed efficiently and effectively.
* Create, manage, and coordinate full cycle recruitment process for engineering, and other professional positions.
* Consult with Hiring Managers to create profiles and post requisitions.
* Use social media, association job boards, and networking to recruit candidates.
* Maintain all pertinent applicant and interview data in applicant tracking system.

4\. Market Intelligence:
  

* Conduct in\-depth market research to stay ahead of industry trends, salary benchmarks, and competitor practices, providing valuable insights to inform recruitment strategies.
* Attend campus recruiting events, manage internship and co\-op programs, and other activities.

5\. Process Improvement:
  

* Identify opportunities for process optimization within the recruitment function and lead initiatives to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
* Implement best practices and continuously evaluate and refine recruitment processes.
* Educate managers on hiring for attributes, behaviors, and technical skills.

6\. Quality of Hire:
  

* Focus on the quality of candidates hired, ensuring they align with the company's values, culture, and long\-term goals.
* Implement methodologies to measure and improve the success and retention of hires.

7\. Talent Pipelining:
  

* Develop and maintain a talent pipeline for critical roles, proactively identifying and engaging with potential candidates to ensure a steady stream of qualified talent.

8\. Collaboration with HR Leadership:
  

* Collaborate with the HR leadership team to ensure alignment of recruitment strategies with broader human resources initiatives.
* Contribute to workforce planning and talent management discussions.

9\. Performance Metrics and Reporting:
  

* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) for the recruitment team and regularly report on metrics, providing insights into recruitment effectiveness.

10\. Employer Branding and External Relations:
  

* Play a key role in enhancing the employer brand, both internally and externally.
* Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to attract top talent and strengthen the organization's reputation.

11\. Regulatory Compliance:
  

* Stay informed about changes in labor laws and regulations related to recruitment and ensure compliance in all recruitment activities.

12\. Leadership and Mentorship:
  

* Provide leadership and guidance to junior recruiters, sharing expertise, and mentoring them in the recruitment process.
* Act as a subject matter expert, offering insights into industry trends, best practices, and effective recruiting strategies.

title: HUMAN RESOURCES (HR) MANAGER / HR LEAD
description:
**About**
 The HR Manager will be responsible for building, managing, and scaling the human capital function at Red Balloon Aerospace. This role goes beyond traditional HR administration and plays a strategic role in talent acquisition, performance management, compliance, culture building, and organizational development for a high\-growth aerospace startup. The HR Manager will work closely with founders, technical leaders, and finance to ensure the right talent, systems, and culture are in place to support innovation, execution, and long\-term growth.
   

  

**Description**
 Skills \& Competencies
   

  

 ‚\- Strong interpersonal and communication skills
   

  

 ‚\- Ability to work hands\-on and independently
   

  

 ‚\- High integrity and confidentiality ‚\- Startup mindset with problem\-solving attitude
   

  

 ‚\- Excellent organizational and documentation skills
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Comfort working with engineers, scientists, and technicians
   

  

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 \| Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Own end\-to\-end recruitment for engineering, operations, R\&D, manufacturing, interns, and business roles
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Develop hiring plans aligned with program milestones and funding stages
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Build strong campus, research institute, and internship pipelines
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Coordinate interviews, offers, onboarding, and background verification
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Support hiring of consultants, advisors, and contractual staff
   

  

 \| HR Operations \& Compliance
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Establish HR policies, SOPs, and employee handbook
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Ensure compliance with Indian labour laws, PF, ESI, gratuity, Shops \& Establishments Act
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Manage employment contracts, NDAs, IP agreements, and exit formalities
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Maintain employee records, attendance, leave, and payroll coordination
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Liaise with auditors, legal, and finance teams on HR matters
   

  

 \| Performance Management \& Employee Development
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Design and implement performance appraisal systems (OKRs/KPIs) should have knowledge on HR tools such as Zoho People, Zoho Recruit, Zoho Payroll.
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Drive goal setting, reviews, feedback cycles, and promotions
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Identify training needs and coordinate technical \& leadership development programs
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Support career path planning for engineers, technicians, and managers
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Digitize and automate attendance, leave, onboarding, payroll inputs, exits, and document management
   

  

**‚Ä¢ Own HR MIS Reporting, Including**
* Headcount \& attrition reports
* Hiring funnel \& time\-to\-hire metrics
* Compensation \& cost\-to\-company (CTC) summaries
* Performance and productivity dashboards


 ‚Ä¢ Provide regular HR dashboards to founders, leadership, and investors
   

  

 \| Culture, Engagement \& Employer Branding
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Build a strong startup culture aligned with Red Balloon's mission and values
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Drive employee engagement initiatives, town halls, and internal communication
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Promote a safety\-first, ethics\-driven, and innovation\-focused work environment
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Support diversity, inclusion, and merit\-based growth
   

  

 \| Compensation, Benefits \& ESOP Management
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Design competitive compensation structures aligned with startup benchmarks
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Support ESOP policy implementation and employee communication
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Manage benefits including insurance, reimbursements, and statutory benefits
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Assist founders in workforce cost planning and budgeting
   

  

 \| Strategic HR \& Scaling Support
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Act as a strategic HR partner to founders during scale\-up phases
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Support organizational design as teams grow (structure, roles, reporting)
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Prepare HR systems for audits, investor diligence, and government programs
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Enable smooth transition from early startup to structured growth stage
   

  

 DESIRED
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ 2\-5 years of HR experience (startup, manufacturing, aerospace, deep\-tech preferred)
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Strong understanding of Indian labour laws and HR compliance
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Proven experience in recruitment, HR operations, and performance management
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Experience working in fast\-growing or founder\-led organizations
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Strong interpersonal and communication skills
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Ability to work hands\-on and independently
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ High integrity and confidentiality
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Startup mindset with problem\-solving attitude
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Excellent organizational and documentation skills
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Comfort working with engineers, scientists, and technicians

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**Role Summary:** 




 The role is responsible for partnering with business functions and departments to establish HR as a strategic enabler by ensuring timely manpower support, effective talent engagement, and efficient workforce management across locations. It focuses on attracting, hiring, and retaining an engaged workforce to support the achievement of HR and organizational objectives.
 



  





 The position also aims to enhance overall HR effectiveness by planning and implementing relevant HR policies, programs, and practices. Additionally, it involves identifying, innovating, and deploying appropriate regional HR interventions that align with the organization’s HR strategy and contribute to improved business performance.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities :** 




  





**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 



* Partner with hiring managers to identify and attract top talent.
* Forecast future manpower needs and ensure timely resource availability.



  





**Business Partnership** 



* Act as a strategic partner to the leadership team by aligning people strategy with business goals.
* Understand business model, targets, and market dynamics to provide proactive HR solutions.
* Support organizational design, role structuring, and manpower planning to drive business performance.



  





**Performance \& Productivity** 



* Drive the performance management process for the location team—goal setting, reviews, and feedback.
* Collaborate with leaders to identify top performers and manage performance gaps.
* Track productivity metrics and contribute to incentive design and recognition programs.



  





**Employee Engagement \& Culture** 



* Build a high\-performance and engagement\-driven culture among the location workforce.
* Design and implement engagement activities suited for a field\-based and target\-driven team.
* Be the employee advocate—ensuring strong communication, feedback mechanisms, and grievance handling.



  





**HR Operations \& Compliance** 



* Ensure smooth execution of HR policies, compensation, and benefits for the organization.
* Maintain data accuracy, reports, and compliance with labour and company policies.



  





**Qualifications** 



* MBA / PGDM with 4 \- 6 years of experience in HR or related field
* Strong organization, communication and conflict resolution skills
* Demonstrated ability to onboard new employees and manage HR tasks
* Proficient in Microsoft Office suite

This role ensures cross tower collaboration, drives technical investigation bridges, manages business\-level communication, and minimizes business impact through structured recovery and escalation.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\nKey Responsibilities\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n1\. Critical Incident Qualification \& Ownership\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Validate proposed P1 incidents against pre defined Critical Incident criteria and formally accept or reject them.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Flag and convert incidents into Critical Incident (P1\) within the ITSM tool after due diligence.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Ensure all required documentation and approval trails are captured before classification.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n2\. Bridge Management \& Technical Coordination\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Open and manage the technical bridge involving all relevant support groups, SMEs, vendors, tower leads, and service owners. \\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Ensure structured troubleshooting, log collection, change validation, and impact assessments are performed by technical teams.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Drive investigation progress every few minutes until stabilization.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n3\. Communication Management \& Broadcasting\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Publish initial and subsequent broadcast communications about issue description, impact, and status updates.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Maintain communication cells when required (MOD, Crisis Manager, business stakeholders).\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Ensure communication follows templates and timelines mandated for Critical Incidents.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n4\. Stakeholder Engagement \& Escalations\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Engage Crisis Manager, Manager\-on\-Duty, Tower Managers, SDMs, and third party vendors as per escalation matrix.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Activate Crisis Cell or Architect Cell when warranted by impact severity.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Serve as the single point of contact for all stakeholders during the P1 lifecycle.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n5\. Documentation, Tracking \& Chronology\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Maintain detailed chronology of events, actions taken, commands executed, team involvement, and decision logs.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Ensure technical teams update resolution comments accurately before closure.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Capture change dependencies, backend logs, alerts, and vendor ticket references. \\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n6\. Handover \& Shift Continuity\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Conduct structured handover to next CIM in shift with all open actions, pending validations, and bridge status.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n7\. Post Resolution Activities\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Validate fix stability post implementation and confirm service restoration with end users or business.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Drive emergency change creation where applicable and capture Change ID details.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Ensure proper closure of incident in alignment with MIP/CIM guidelines.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\nCore Skills \& Competencies\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Strong understanding of ITIL Major Incident / Incident Management.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Ability to coordinate multi vendor \& cross tower environments under high pressure.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Excellent communication skills for broadcast, stakeholder messaging, and executive escalation.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Strong analytical approach to validate impact, troubleshoot high severity issues, and guide technical towers.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Ability to run bridges assertively with control and clarity.\\\\\\\\r\\\\\\\\n• Experien
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
1\. To adhere to quality standards, regulatory requirements and company policies.
  
2\. To provide support for complex incidents, escalated by analysts, perform root cause analysis, and implement solutions to resolve technical \& security issues.
  
3\. To work on value adding activities such Knowledge base update \& management, training freshers, coaching analyst.
  
4\. To resolve complex tickets within agreed SLAs and collaborate with other support teams to ensure seamless operations \& security posture.
  
5\. To ensure positive customer experience and CSAT through First Call Resolution , minimum rejected resolutions / reopen Cases and mitigating security threats.

description:
FOR TECH ENTHUSIASTS, INNOVATORS \& VISIONARIES
At Constelli, we don't just build signal processing systems, we engineer the future of Defense and Aerospace technologies. If you're someone who thrives on complexity, innovation, and impact, this is where your journey begins.
We're a team of passionate engineers, researchers, and problem\-solvers driven by purpose and united by a shared vision: to develop real\-time electronically intelligent systems and advanced algorithms that empower mission\-critical platforms across India's defense ecosystem.
WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON
Whatever you're designing DSP algorithms, Architecting Telemetry Systems, Testing RF Platforms, or Simulating EW environment, your work at Constelli will matter. Our projects span:
Software \- defined Radar simulators.
Telemetry and Target Tracking System.
Sensor Fusion, Electronic Warfare \& AI\-enabled platforms.
Field Deployment of Critical Defense Infrastructure.
Who Thrives Here
Curious minds who go beyond job descriptions .
Engineers who love building systems from the ground up.
Innovators who turn edge cases into launchpads.
Freshers and interns from ECE/CSE/EIE backgrounds eager to learn and lead.
What You’ll Experience
End\-to\-End Ownership: From concept to deployment, your ideas take flight.
Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work shoulder to shoulder with experts in Hardware, Software, RF, and Systems Design.
Dynamic Culture: We believe great work happens when you're happy and heard.
Career Acceleration: Mentorship, real\-time feedback, and opportunities to lead from Day 1\.
  
#### **About Us**



We are a dynamic team of engineers, researchers, and domain experts who build advanced signal processing solutions for **Defence, Aerospace, and Research applications**. Our work spans high\-performance communication systems, Telemetry Receivers, Radar Processing, and mission\-critical signal processing platforms. We focus on solving complex real\-world problems by developing state\-of\-the\-art DSP algorithms and high\-performance implementations for RF, FPGA, Embedded Processors, and high\-speed computing platforms.


#### **About the role**



We are looking for a Sr. Algorithm Developer – DSP who can design, analyze, and implement advanced signal processing algorithms from first principles. This role requires strong theoretical foundations in DSP and communications, along with the ability to translate research literature (IEEE papers, standards, and technical publications) into working algorithms and optimized implementations. The role also involves studying existing algorithms and improving their performance, robustness, and computational efficiency for real\-world deployment.



The candidate will work on communication and radar signal processing algorithms including modulators, demodulators, synchronization techniques, channel coding, detection, estimation, and performance optimization.

  



#### **Key Responsibilities**


* Study and derive algorithms from **IEEE papers, research publications, standards, and technical documentation**.
* Develop DSP algorithms for **Digital Communication systems and Radar Signal Processing**.
* Design algorithms for:
	+ Modulation \& demodulation (PCM/FM, SOQPSK, CPM, QPSK, QAM etc.)
	+ Synchronization (carrier, symbol, timing recovery)
	+ Channel coding \& decoding (LDPC, Turbo, Reed\-Solomon, etc.)
	+ Filtering, estimation, and detection algorithms
	+ Radar signal processing techniques
* Implement algorithms using MATLAB / Python for modelling and simulation.
* Convert algorithms into high\-performance implementations in C/C\+\+ or FPGA\-friendly architectures using RTL.
* Validate algorithms through simulation, mathematical analysis, and test data.
* Analyze existing algorithm implementations and improve:

You will be responsible for the complete software lifecycle—from board bring\-up and secure boot implementation to creating custom PetaLinux distributions and high\-performance device drivers—ensuring robust operation of the ARM Cortex\-A53/A72 and Cortex\-R5 subsystems on Zynq UltraScale\+ and Versal Adaptive SoCs.

title: Software Support Executive
description:
**About the Role :**

This role is ideal for freshers or early\-career professionals who communicate well in writing, enjoy solving problems, and want to build a career in customer support and SaaS. Full product training is provided, so prior experience is welcome but not required.

Because you speak with customers all day, you will also have the chance to earn performance incentives \- by recommending useful upgrades and add\-ons and by referring new leads \- on top of your fixed salary.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Respond to customer queries over live chat promptly, professionally, and with a friendly tone.
* Understand each customer’s problem, troubleshoot it, and guide them to a clear solution.
* Manage several chat conversations at the same time without letting quality slip.
* Escalate complex or technical issues to the relevant team and follow up until they are resolved.
* Spot opportunities to recommend relevant upgrades or add\-ons (cross\-sell and upsell) during conversations, and encourage referrals \- passing qualified leads to the sales team.

* Record conversations accurately and keep customer information up to date.
* Share recurring problems and customer feedback with the product and support teams.
* Help improve our help center by suggesting or drafting support articles.

**Required Skills (Must\-Have) :**

* **Strong English communication is mandatory** \- clear written English with correct grammar, spelling, and a warm, professional tone.
* Good typing speed and accuracy (around 35\-40 words per minute or higher).
* Strong reading comprehension to quickly understand what a customer needs.
* A patient, empathetic, and customer\-first attitude.
* Ability to multitask and stay organized while handling multiple chats.
* Comfort using computers and web\-based applications.
* A quick learner who can pick up our product and processes.
* Fresher to 1 year of experience (customer support internships count).

**Good to Have :**

* Familiarity with SaaS products, especially HRMS, Payroll, or related domains.
* A natural ability to notice customer needs and suggest the right solution (helpful for cross\-sell, upsell, and referral incentives).
* Ability to communicate in Hindi or other regional languages.
* Any prior customer support, BPO, or internship experience.

**What We Offer :**

* **Performance incentives** for cross\-sell, upsell, and new lead referrals \- in addition to your fixed salary.
* Structured onboarding and full product training \- no prior experience needed.
* A supportive team and a clear path to grow into senior support, QA, or customer success roles.

title: Engineer I (QA)
description:
At Aristocrat, we are dedicated to crafting world\-class gaming experiences that deliver happiness to millions of players worldwide. As we keep innovating and raising standards in the gaming sector, we seek driven and passionate people to join our team. This opportunity is outstanding for those eager to be part of a dynamic and inclusive culture promoting collaboration and creativity. As an Engineer I (QA), you will have a key role in guaranteeing the flawless delivery of our games and supporting our mission to provide high\-quality, entertaining slot games on advanced platforms.
   

  

 What You'll Do
 * Test C\+\+ based Class 2 games (US and RSA), HHR \& NYL games across various kinds of gaming hardware/cabinets.
* Ensure high\-quality standards of games are delivered around the world.
* Collaborate with developers and other QA engineers to identify and resolve defects.
* Build, maintain, and complete test plans and test cases.
* Perform regression testing to ensure existing functionalities remain unaffected by new developments.
* Report and document bugs and issues, providing detailed information for the development team.
* Participate in code reviews to provide insights on potential quality issues.
* Analyze game performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Assist in the development of automated test scripts to increase testing efficiency.
* Stay updated with the latest industry trends and testing methodologies.


 What We're Looking For
 * Between 1\-2 years of experience in software testing, ideally within the gaming sector.
* Proficiency in testing C\+\+ based applications.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and dedication to quality.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Familiarity with various testing tools and methodologies.
* Experience with automated testing is a plus.
* A passion for gaming and a keen interest in game development.


 Join us at Aristocrat, where your skills and passion for quality will thrive in an encouraging and innovative environment. We look forward to welcoming you to our team and achieving new heights together!
   

  

 Why Aristocrat?
   

  

 Aristocrat is a world leader in gaming content and technology, and a top\-tier publisher of free\-to\-play mobile games. We deliver great performance for our B2B customers and bring joy to the lives of the millions of people who love to play our casino and mobile games. And while we focus on fun, we never forget our responsibilities. We strive to lead the way in responsible gameplay, and to lift the bar in company governance, employee wellbeing and sustainability. We’re a diverse business united by shared values and an inspiring mission to bring joy to life through the power of play.
   

  

 We aim to create an environment where individual differences are valued, and all employees have the opportunity to realize their potential. We welcome and encourage applications from all people regardless of age, gender, race, ethnicity, cultural background, disability status or LGBTQ\+ identity. EEO M/F/D/V
 * World Leader in Gaming Entertainment
* Robust benefits package
* Global career opportunities


 Our Values
 * All about the Player
* Talent Unleashed
* Collective Brilliance
* Good Business Good Citizen


**Travel Expectations**
 None
   

  

**Additional Information**
*At this time, we are unable to sponsor work visas for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the job posting location for this position on a full\-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.*

title: QA Engineer
description:
**About Astound Digital**
 At Astound Digital, we are pioneers in the digital landscape, dedicated to transforming how the world interacts with technology, data, and creativity. Our role as trusted advisors in the digital landscape empowers the world’s most innovative brands with frictionless, end\-to\-end customer experiences. We are known for our comprehensive solutions, proven expertise, and collaborative, nimble approach that instills confidence in our clients. We embrace the power of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to drive innovation, efficiency, and better outcomes for our clients and employees. Join us to navigate and lead in the ever\-changing digital world, where your impact will extend beyond the ordinary.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 As a QA Engineer, you will be an integral member of a high\-performance, feature\-driven team dedicated to ensuring the quality and reliability of complex eCommerce solutions. You will be responsible for the full testing lifecycle, from analyzing intricate business requirements to executing detailed test cases and verifying critical bug fixes. Your role is essential in maintaining the high standards required for enterprise\-level digital products, working collaboratively across technical teams to mitigate risks. By providing proactive recommendations and ensuring flawless third\-party integrations, you will help deliver seamless and high\-quality digital experiences for our global clients.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Analyze complex business requirements to design, document, and execute comprehensive test cases that ensure product integrity.
* Identify, report, and track software defects within bug\-tracking systems, ensuring thorough verification of all fixes.
* Provide accurate effort estimations for individual features and assigned tasks to support project planning and timelines.
* Actively participate in daily project meetings and brainstorming sessions to address technical issues and quality risks.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional project teams to maintain a unified approach to quality assurance.
* Conduct rigorous integration testing for third\-party services and external components within the eCommerce ecosystem.
* Propose improvements for QA\-related procedures, tools, and systems to the QA Lead and Project Managers.
* Maintain clear and consistent reporting on test results and overall product quality status for internal stakeholders.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Minimum 3 years of professional software testing experience with a strong theoretical foundation in QA methodologies.
* Proven experience in requirement analysis, test case creation, and comprehensive reporting of test results.
* Hands\-on expertise with bug\-tracking systems and a deep understanding of the defect lifecycle.
* Intermediate English communication skills, both spoken and written, for effective collaboration in a global environment.
* Demonstrated ability to test third\-party integrations and complex web\-based applications.
* Proficiency in estimating testing efforts for specific features or individual task loads.
* Strong team player with the ability to adapt quickly to changing project needs and dynamic environments.
* Familiarity with tools such as Postman, JIRA, Confluence, or JMeter is highly desirable.


 What we offer in return
   

  

* Global Collaboration: The opportunity to work daily with diverse and talented professionals across the globe.
* Off\-the\-Charts Career Growth: Сlear career path and a performance review system, career coaching, training and certifications, mentoring and knowledge sharing.
* Well\-being Is Top Priority: Parental leave, paid time off, comprehensive health and medical plans.
* Real Work\-Life Balance: Dependent on location, we offer remote, in\-office, or hybrid working modes; flexible hours; work\-life balance support on every stage and level.


 Why work for Astound Digital?
   

  

 Whether you’re working directly with our world\-renowned clients or with your Astound colleagues from around the globe, you will shape the future of digital commerce, using emerging technologies and innovative approaches.
   

  

**Grow your career with Astound Digital, and discover exciting opportunities while doing the work you love!**

title: Full Stack Engineer (Fresher)
description:
Full Stack Engineer (Fresher)

Location: Remote (India)

Employment Type: Full\-time

Experience: Fresher (0–1 Year)

Compensation: ₹4,00,000 – ₹5,50,000 per year

Build production\-ready AI products used by real job seekers. As a Full Stack Engineer at ResuPulse, you'll work directly with the founder to develop modern web applications using Next.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and AI technologies. This role offers hands\-on ownership, mentorship, and the opportunity to contribute to real features from your first day.

About the Role

We're looking for a motivated Full Stack Engineer who enjoys building products, solving technical challenges, and learning modern software engineering practices. You'll contribute across the entire stack—from designing intuitive user interfaces to developing scalable backend services and AI\-powered features.

Working directly with the founder, you'll gain experience building and shipping production software while collaborating on product decisions and technical architecture.

Key Responsibilities

* Build and maintain end\-to\-end product features using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and MongoDB.
* Develop scalable backend APIs, business logic, and database models.
* Design clean, responsive, and accessible user interfaces.
* Build and improve AI\-powered features for resume analysis, job matching, and career assistance.
* Debug issues, optimize application performance, and improve reliability.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented production code.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical discussions.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in B.Tech, BCA, MCA, Computer Science, or a related field (2025–2026 graduates or recent graduates).
* Strong understanding of JavaScript and TypeScript.
* Experience with React or another modern frontend framework.
* Basic understanding of REST APIs and software development principles.
* Familiarity with SQL or NoSQL databases.
* Comfortable using Git for version control.
* At least one personal, academic, freelance, or open\-source project that demonstrates your skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Next.js App Router.
* Familiarity with MongoDB and Mongoose.
* Experience integrating AI or LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Groq, or similar platforms.
* A deployed application or portfolio showcasing your work.

Technology Stack

* Next.js 16
* React
* TypeScript
* MongoDB Atlas
* Tailwind CSS
* AI/LLM Integration (Groq)
* Git \& GitHub

What You'll Get

* Direct mentorship from the founder.
* Ownership of real production features from day one.
* Experience building AI\-powered products used by real customers.
* Exposure to frontend, backend, databases, cloud services, and AI technologies.
* A collaborative, fast\-moving engineering environment with significant learning opportunities.

About ResuPulse

ResuPulse is an AI\-powered career platform helping job seekers build stronger careers through intelligent technology. Our platform provides resume analysis, AI resume building, cover letter generation, LinkedIn profile optimization, job matching, and career guidance.

As an early\-stage, product\-focused company, we're building modern AI solutions that solve real hiring challenges. Every feature we ship is used in production, giving engineers the opportunity to create meaningful impact while working with modern technologies.

Equal Opportunity Employer

* ResuPulse is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone. Employment decisions are made based on qualifications, skills, and business needs. If you require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process, we're happy to support you.

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 \- ₹450,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

title: IoT & Embedded Systems Engineer (Fresher)
description:
We are looking for a passionate and motivated IoT \& Embedded Systems Engineer (Fresher) to join our engineering team. This is an excellent opportunity for recent graduates who are enthusiastic about working with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, embedded systems, IoT devices, sensors, automation, and hardware integration.

You will work alongside experienced engineers on real\-world IoT projects involving hardware prototyping, firmware development, sensor integration, communication protocols, cloud connectivity, device testing, and deployment. This role provides hands\-on experience in building intelligent connected devices for industrial, healthcare, smart building, and enterprise automation applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and program applications for Arduino and Raspberry Pi platforms.
* Configure and integrate IoT devices with various sensors and actuators.
* Interface hardware modules such as relays, displays, cameras, motors, RFID, GPS, and GSM modules.
* Develop firmware for microcontrollers using C/C\+\+ and Python.
* Design and implement communication between IoT devices and cloud platforms.
* Configure and troubleshoot hardware peripherals and embedded systems.
* Build prototypes for automation, monitoring, and control systems.
* Work with communication protocols such as MQTT, HTTP, TCP/IP, UART, SPI, and I2C.
* Connect IoT devices with REST APIs and cloud services.
* Test, debug, and optimize embedded applications.
* Collaborate with software, AI, and hardware teams.
* Document hardware configurations, wiring diagrams, and technical specifications.
* Learn new embedded technologies and contribute to innovative IoT solutions.

**Eligibility**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, or a related field.
* Good understanding of embedded systems and IoT concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Familiarity with Arduino and Raspberry Pi through academic or personal projects.
* Basic electronics knowledge, including circuits, sensors, and microcontrollers.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

**Required Skills**

* **Strong programming skills** in **C, C\+\+, and Python**, with basic knowledge of **Shell Scripting** (preferred).
* **Embedded systems development** using **Arduino, Raspberry Pi, ESP32, and ESP8266**, with expertise in **Embedded C, GPIO, interrupts, PWM, timers, and serial communication**.
* **Hands\-on experience with sensors, hardware, and communication protocols**, including **temperature, humidity, PIR, ultrasonic, gas, light, pressure, accelerometer/gyroscope, RFID, GPS, GSM/4G, camera modules, motors, relays, LCD/OLED displays**, and protocols such as **UART, SPI, I2C, MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, Bluetooth, and Wi\-Fi**.
* **Familiarity with Linux\-based environments, IoT platforms, and databases**, including **Ubuntu, Raspberry Pi OS, Node\-RED, ThingsBoard, AWS IoT, Firebase, SQLite, MySQL, and PostgreSQL**.
* **Proficiency with embedded development tools and hardware debugging**, including **Arduino IDE, VS Code, PlatformIO, Git, Postman, PuTTY, Serial Monitor, sensor wiring, PCB prototyping, breadboard design, soldering, multimeter usage, and circuit debugging**.
* **Basic understanding of advanced embedded and IoT concepts**, including **Home Automation, Industrial IoT, Robotics, Smart Devices, Embedded Linux, Edge Computing, Computer Vision on Raspberry Pi, and AI on Edge Devices**.

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Real people. Real service.**
 At SupplyHouse.com, we value every individual team member and cultivate a community where people come first. Led by our core values of
 **G** 
 enerosity,
 **R** 
 espect,
 **I** 
 nnovation,
 **T** 
 eamwork, and GRIT, we’re dedicated to maintaining a supportive work environment that celebrates diversity and empowers everyone to reach their full potential. As an industry\-leading e\-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers.
   

  

 Through an Employer of Record (EOR), we are looking for a new
 **Cloud Infrastructure Engineer** 
 in India to join our growing IT Team. This individual will report into our VP, IT and will support, maintain, and enhance our cloud and production infrastructure environments with a strong focus on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Kubernetes operations, infrastructure automation, and platform reliability. If you are experienced in cloud infrastructure operations, Kubernetes administration, infrastructure automation, CI/CD support, and production incident management, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

**Role Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Location:** 
 Remote from India
   

  

**Schedule:** 
 Monday through Friday with a minimum schedule overlap of 4\-5 hours per day with 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time to ensure effective collaboration
   

  

**Base Salary:** 
 $20,258 \- $25,660 USD per year
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
*Cloud Infrastructure Management*
* Manage/maintain production infrastructure across dev, staging, and production environments
* Support deployment, configuration, scaling, and lifecycle management of cloud services
* Monitor system health, performance, availability, and capacity
* Handle patching, upgrades, and maintenance activities
* Ensure infrastructure reliability, uptime, and operational stability


*Kubernetes \& Containers*
* Support Kubernetes\-based workloads and cluster operations
* Assist with container orchestration, deployments, scaling, and troubleshooting
* Maintain operational standards/best practices for containerized infrastructure
* Partner with dev teams on application deployments and environment issues


*Automation \& CI/CD*
* Develop and maintain automation scripts/tooling for operational efficiency
* Support infrastructure automation and provisioning via IaC
* Assist with CI/CD pipeline integrations and deployment automation
* Contribute to continuous improvement for scalability and reliability


*Security \& Access Management*
* Manage access control, IAM configs, and user permissions
* Support security best practices and compliance requirements
* Assist with vulnerability remediation and infrastructure hardening
* Maintain auditability and operational governance standards


*Incident Response \& Support*
* Perform incident response, troubleshooting, root cause analysis
* Participate in on\-call rotations
* Collaborate with internal teams on infrastructure/platform/application issues
* Develop and maintain runbooks, docs, and support procedures


*Database Operations*
* Manage backup, restore, recovery, and maintenance
* Perform patching/upgrades/lifecycle management for MariaDB
* Monitor availability, performance, and data integrity
* Troubleshoot connectivity/performance issues with app teams


**Requirements:**
* High\-level proficiency of written and verbal communication in English
* 3–5 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, platform engineering, or infrastructure operations
* Hands\-on experience supporting Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments
* Experience with Kubernetes administration and containerized workloads
* Strong understanding of Linux systems administration and infrastructure troubleshooting
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform
* Experience supporting CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation workflows
* Familiarity with cloud networking concepts including VPCs, DNS, load balancing, and firewalls
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting platforms
* Working knowledge of IAM, access control, and infrastructure security best practices
* Experience supporting production systems and incident management processes
* Experience with MariaDB or similar relational database platforms
* Google Cloud certifications such as: Associate Cloud Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer
* Experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Cloud Build
* Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Splunk
* Experience with scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* Exposure to SRE principles and operational excellence practices
* Experience supporting hybrid cloud or multi\-cloud environments

+ Comprehensive and affordable medical, dental, vision, and life insurance options
+ Competitive Provident Fund contributions
+ Paid time off and holidays
+ Mental health support and wellbeing program
+ Company\-provided equipment and one\-time $250 USD work from home stipend

+ Company rewards and recognition program
+ And more!
