title: Senior RF Design Engineer +
description:
FOR TECH ENTHUSIASTS, INNOVATORS \& VISIONARIES
At Constelli, we don't just build signal processing systems, we engineer the future of Defense and Aerospace technologies. If you're someone who thrives on complexity, innovation, and impact, this is where your journey begins.
We're a team of passionate engineers, researchers, and problem\-solvers driven by purpose and united by a shared vision: to develop real\-time electronically intelligent systems and advanced algorithms that empower mission\-critical platforms across India's defense ecosystem.
WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON
Whatever you're designing DSP algorithms, Architecting Telemetry Systems, Testing RF Platforms, or Simulating EW environment, your work at Constelli will matter. Our projects span:
Software \- defined Radar simulators.
Telemetry and Target Tracking System.
Sensor Fusion, Electronic Warfare \& AI\-enabled platforms.
Field Deployment of Critical Defense Infrastructure.
Who Thrives Here
Curious minds who go beyond job descriptions .
Engineers who love building systems from the ground up.
Innovators who turn edge cases into launchpads.
Freshers and interns from ECE/CSE/EIE backgrounds eager to learn and lead.
What You’ll Experience
End\-to\-End Ownership: From concept to deployment, your ideas take flight.
Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work shoulder to shoulder with experts in Hardware, Software, RF, and Systems Design.
Dynamic Culture: We believe great work happens when you're happy and heard.
Career Acceleration: Mentorship, real\-time feedback, and opportunities to lead from Day 1\.
  
#### **About Us**



We are a dynamic team of young engineers, domain experts, and seasoned sales professionals dedicated to providing comprehensive turnkey solutions for complex challenges in Signal Processing. Our expertise spans the cutting\-edge technologies in Signal Processing, addressing critical needs in the Defence and Aerospace sectors. Our offerings encompass a wide range of solutions, from tactical radios and radar systems to extensive research and mission\-critical applications.


#### **About the role**



As a Senior RF Hardware Design Engineer, you will play a key role in the architecture, design, simulation, implementation, bring\-up, and verification of RF and microwave hardware subsystems for aerospace and defence applications.



The role includes RF signal\-chain design from antenna port to baseband, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution, and wideband RF front\-end modules operating up to 40 GHz. The engineer will translate system\-level requirements into circuit\-level specifications and support the complete hardware development cycle from concept to qualification and production support.



#### **Key Responsibilities**


* **Circuit Design \& Analysis**
	+ Design and optimize RF/microwave circuits and subsystems, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, VCOs, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution circuits, and RF front\-end modules up to 40 GHz.
	+ Perform RF system and circuit\-level analysis, including link budget, cascaded gain/noise figure, IP2/IP3, P1dB, dynamic range, SFDR, phase noise, jitter, LO leakage, image rejection, harmonic/spurious analysis, EVM, and emissions performance.
	+ Develop and execute RF simulation models using tools such as Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent tools for linear, nonlinear, EM, and system\-level co\-simulation.
	+ Select and qualify active/passive RF components and design with GaN/GaAs/SiGe/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices.
	+ Define component derating, worst\-case analysis, lifecycle risk, alternate part strategy, and reliability considerations for high\-reliability aerospace and defence hardware.
	+ Translate system\-level requirements such as frequency range, sensitivity, output power, EVM, phase noise, isolation, spur level, and dynamic range into verifiable RF circuit and subsystem specifications.
* **Systems Architecture \& Integration**
	+ Contribute to RF subsystem architecture trade studies and module\-level implementation planning.
	+ Lead antenna\-to\-baseband RF signal\-chain design for radar, EW, telemetry, tactical radio, SDR, wideband receiver, and up/down\-converter applications.
	+ Work with system engineers to allocate RF performance budgets and cascade gain, noise figure, linearity, filtering, isolation, and dynamic range from antenna port to ADC/DAC interface.
	+ Define LO and clock architecture, including reference clock distribution, PLL/synthesizer selection, phase noise budgeting, spur management, synchronization, and frequency settling requirements.
	+ Guide and review RF PCB layout, including stack\-up selection, controlled impedance routing, RF via transitions, grounding, return\-current paths, shielding, cavity isolation, connector transitions, and mixed\-signal partitioning.
	+ Support mechanical and thermal integration, including RF shielding, heat sinking, enclosure effects, RF cable/connector selection, vibration considerations, and high\-power PA thermal design.
	+ Support integration with FPGA, firmware, embedded software, and DSP teams from the RF hardware side, including AGC, DPD, calibration, JESD204/LVDS interfaces, timing, synchronization, and hardware control interfaces.
* **Product Development \& Qualification**
	+ Define and execute RF test plans covering conducted and radiated measurements, including S\-parameters, gain, gain flatness, return loss, output power, P1dB, IP3, noise figure, phase noise, EVM, ACLR/ACPR, harmonic/spurious emissions, receiver sensitivity, blocking, isolation, and EMI/EMC pre\-compliance.
	+ Perform prototype bring\-up, lab debugging, tuning, rework support, failure analysis, oscillation/debug, spur hunting, desense investigation, thermal drift analysis, and simulation\-to\-measurement correlation.
	+ Support design readiness and qualification activities for MIL\-STD\-461 EMC and MIL\-STD\-810 environmental requirements.
	+ Support production transfer, including DFM/DFT review, BOM alternate qualification, test fixture definition, production test procedures, and yield/debug support.
	+ Maintain design documentation, including schematics, RF PCB specifications, simulation reports, test procedures, test reports, analysis reports, interface control documents, compliance matrices, and verification evidence.
	+ Prepare and present PDR/CDR material, technical status, risk items, and design trade\-off summaries to program managers, internal teams, and external customers.

#### **Required Qualifications**


* B.Tech / M.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or closely related field.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on RF/microwave circuit and subsystem design experience in an aerospace, defence environment
* Demonstrated proficiency with at least two RF EDA tools: Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent.
* Strong command of RF test equipment: VNA, Spectrum Analyzer, signal generator, noise\-figure Analyzer, Oscilloscope and power meters.
* Experience designing with GaN/GaAs/SiGe/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices.
* Familiarity with MIL\-STD\-461, MIL\-STD\-810, and MIL\-HDBK\-217 requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce and defend technical documentation in a program environment


**Preferred**  




* M.S. or Ph.D. in RF / Microwave Engineering or related discipline
* Experience with Radar, Electronic warfare (EW), or Telemetry systems
* Familiarity with VHDL/Verilog or Python/MATLAB for test automation and signal processing support.


#### **Employee status and commitments**


* Permanent full\-time position located at our Hyderabad office, with regular on\-site visits to clients and vendor locations.
* Overtime may be necessary to ensure the timely delivery of client projects.
* Weekend work is uncommon but may occasionally be required.

#### **Why join US?**


* **Culture of Excellence:** We are committed to fostering a culture where every individual can thrive, grow, and make a difference.
* **Opportunities for Growth:** We believe in investing in our people and providing opportunities for professional development and advancement.
* **Collaborative Culture:** Join a collaborative and supportive work environment where your contributions are valued and recognized.
* **Innovative Environment:** Be part of a team that thrives on innovation and is committed to pushing the boundaries of RF technology.

title: iti electrician
description:
**Job Title:** ITI Electrician  
**Department:** Life Science  
**Location:** \[Company Location]  
**Reporting To:** Electronics Engineer / Department Head

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a dedicated **ITI Electrician** to support the **Life Science Department** in the assembly, wiring, testing, installation, and maintenance of laboratory and scientific equipment. The ideal candidate should possess sound electrical knowledge, troubleshooting skills, and a commitment to quality and safety.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform electrical wiring and assembly of laboratory and life science instruments.
* Read and understand electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, and circuit layouts.
* Install and connect electrical components such as switches, relays, power supplies, sensors, MCBs, and control panels.
* Conduct functional testing and electrical inspection of equipment before dispatch.
* Troubleshoot and repair electrical faults in laboratory equipment and machines.
* Assist in the installation, commissioning, and servicing of equipment at customer sites when required.
* Carry out preventive maintenance to ensure equipment reliability and performance.
* Maintain daily work records, testing reports, and service documentation.
* Ensure compliance with company quality standards, electrical safety practices, and 5S procedures.
* Coordinate with the Production, Mechanical, Quality, and Service teams for smooth project execution.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and assist in new product development activities.

**Qualification**

* ITI in **Electrician** (NCVT/SCVT).
* Freshers or candidates with **1–3 years of experience** are welcome to apply.

**Required Skills**

* Knowledge of electrical wiring and industrial electrical systems.
* Ability to read electrical schematics and wiring diagrams.
* Hands\-on experience with multimeters, crimping tools, and other electrical testing instruments.
* Basic understanding of electrical panels, sensors, SMPS, relays, and motors.
* Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail and quality.
* Willingness to travel for installation and service assignments, if required.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in laboratory equipment, life science instruments, medical devices, automation systems, or pharmaceutical equipment will be an added advantage.

Pay: ₹8,338\.82 \- ₹29,964\.30 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Manager - Medical Science
description:
**Title:** **Manager \- Medical Science**
=========================================

Date: Jul 10, 2026
Location: Sun House \- Corporate Office
Company: Sun Pharma Laboratories Ltd
**Job Title:**  


Manager \- Medical Science**Business Unit:**  

**MACR**  

**Location:**  


Mumbai  


At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you **“Create your own sunshine”**— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.

Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?  



As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self\-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”  


**YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**
* Medical monitoring activity which includes eligibility assessment based on inclusion, exclusion criteria and detailed medical history, review of study endpoint data review and safety investigations.
* Preparation of synopsis, protocol, Clinical Study Report (CSR) and present the proposals in subject’s expert committee (SEC) regulatory meeting.
* Collaborate with clinicians, KOL to get the feedback and inputs on clinical trial design, comparator and endpoints of the study to finalize synopsis.
* Review of patient eligibility and approval of patients through Interactive Response Technology (IRT) system
* Work with data management team to review timely data extract and participate in data cleaning activities to ensure timely database lock and release of tables, figures, and listings (TLFs).
* Training the study team on protocol and applied aspect of the protocol to clarify the relevance and criticality of each activity considering the study endpoints.
* Interact with investigator to resolve the queries related with protocol from the sites and Ethics Committee.
* Review of AE and SAEs forms and provide review comments in timely manner
* Medical writing of scientific documents
Planning publications activities for clinical journal manuscripts, clinical journal abstracts, and study article. Identify additional clinical data analysis in collaboration with statistics team and subsequently submission and present the data in scientific forums  
* 
  

**Job Requirements**  


**Educational Qualification**  


MBBS \+MD (Pharmacology)  


**Experience**  


1 \-2 years previous work experience.  


**Skills required include:**  


* MD (Pharmacology) or other relevant medical qualification with 1\-2 years of relevant experience or fresher.
* Experience in working in clinical science domain working in different capacities as medical monitor for clinical trial/ medical expert for clinical development plan for products across therapies is desirable.

title: Fitness Trainer
description:
**About StrengthSkap**

At StrengthSkap, we believe that movement is medicine and strength is a lifelong investment. We are not a traditional gym or a conventional physiotherapy clinic—we are an integrated movement and performance studio where physiotherapists, strength \& conditioning coaches, nutritionists, and movement specialists work together to help people move better, become stronger, recover faster, and perform at their best. Whether it’s helping someone overcome persistent pain, returning an athlete to sport, or enabling an older adult to move confidently, our approach is built on science, collaboration, and coaching. Role Overview We are looking for a passionate Physical Trainer who believes that exercise is more than burning calories—it is a tool to improve movement quality, resilience, and long\-term health. The ideal candidate will coach clients using evidence\-based strength and conditioning principles while working closely with physiotherapists to bridge rehabilitation and performance. You should be equally comfortable coaching a beginner with back pain, an athlete preparing for competition, or someone simply looking to move better.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct comprehensive movement and physical fitness assessments.
* Design personalised strength and conditioning programmes based on individual goals, movement capacity, injury history, and assessment findings.
* Coach clients through safe and effective resistance training, functional movement, mobility, and conditioning sessions.
* Progress and regress exercises appropriately based on client ability.
* Work collaboratively with physiotherapists to transition clients from rehabilitation to independent strength training.
* Monitor exercise technique and ensure safe execution at all times.
* Educate clients on movement quality, recovery, injury prevention, and sustainable training habits.
* Maintain detailed client records, training progress, and assessment outcomes.
* Support sports performance programmes for recreational and competitive athletes.
* Contribute to workshops, community events, and educational initiatives conducted by StrengthSkap.

Participate in regular case discussions and continuous professional development.

**Required Qualifications**

* Certification in Strength \& Conditioning or Personal Training
* Freshers with strong practical knowledge are welcome to apply.
* Experience in coaching resistance training, functional training, or athletic development is an advantage.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong understanding of human movement and exercise biomechanics.
* Knowledge of strength training principles and programme design.
* Ability to coach clients across different age groups and fitness levels.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to work in a multidisciplinary environment.
* Strong observational and coaching skills.
* Growth mindset with a commitment to continuous learning.

**What We Value We hire people who:**

* Put movement quality before intensity.
* Coach with empathy and professionalism.
* Value collaboration over hierarchy.
* Believe in evidence\-based practice.
* Take ownership of client outcomes.
* Continuously seek to learn and improve.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**


The Corporate Finance team sits at the heart of OakNorth's financial operations, covering reporting, planning, and control across our UK and international entities. The team works closely with FP\&A, Treasury, Legal, Operations, and the business to ensure robust financial governance and continuous process improvement.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


We are looking for an experienced Finance Controllership professional to join our Corporate Finance team. In this role you will own end\-to\-end accounting and reporting across both internal and external requirements — working under IFRS and Indian GAAP — while leading a broad array of planning projects and process improvement initiatives that directly support OakNorth's growth ambitions.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own day\-to\-day accounting, month\-end closing, and periodic reporting in accordance with IFRS and Indian GAAP.
* Manage end\-to\-end accounting, valuation, and bank reconciliations for complex financial instruments including Investments, Borrowings, Loans, Deposits, and Derivatives (hedging compliance).
* Prepare Balance Sheet and P\&L items including prepayments, accruals, depreciation runs, intercompany entries, and other month\-end journals.
* Lead Fixed Assets and Intangible accounting, related schedules, and physical verifications; maintain General Ledger, vendor, and bank reconciliations.
* Support Statutory and Internal audits, preparing schedules, responding to auditor queries, and drafting internal notes/memos for approvals and audit evidence.
* Drive process standardisation and automation using data tools and AI\-enabled solutions in treasury and accounting workflows; draft and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (FP\&A, Operations, Legal, Credit/Portfolio Monitoring, Treasury, and the business) to identify process improvement opportunities and enhance the control environment.
* Prepare test scenarios and perform testing for system automation projects; assist with ad hoc projects as required.

**YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE…**

* CA (Fresher)/CPA/MBA in Finance with 4–5 years of progressive experience demonstrating strong accounting expertise and advanced financial analytical skills.
* Strong Microsoft Excel and MS Office skills with a focus on reporting automation; ability to prioritise and manage multiple workflows simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills, with experience working across multiple functions and geographies in a fast\-paced organisation.
* Self\-driven, proactive, and results\-oriented mindset with a continuous improvement outlook; comfortable operating at scale with a hands\-on attitude and big\-picture thinking.

**Nice to Have**

* Background in the banking or financial services sector.
* Experience with or interest in data automation tools such as Python/Pandas or VBA for automating reconciliations and reporting processes.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* **Health \& Protection:** Comprehensive medical cover for you, your family, and parents, along with life and accidental insurance cover at a multiple of your salary.
* **Wellbeing:** Annual health check\-ups, online doctor consultations, pharmacy discounts, nutritionist support, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services — all sponsored by OakNorth.
* **Time Off:** Earned leave, casual/sick leave, public holidays, maternity leave, and paternity leave.
* **Life Milestones:** Financial support for important life events such as marriage, childbirth, and bereavement.
* **Flexible Benefits:** Tax\-efficient allowances for internet, fuel, meals, leave travel, and National Pension System (NPS) contributions.

We are a dynamic team of young engineers, domain experts, and seasoned sales professionals dedicated to providing comprehensive turnkey solutions for complex challenges in Signal Processing. We are looking for an experienced and driven Technical Sales Professionals to support our B2G (Business\-to\-Government) sales processes. * Conduct on\-site customer meetings, presentations, and demonstrations to showcase tailored technical solutions.

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Electronics/Electrical/Instrumentation Engineering (EE/EC/EIE).

* Excellent interpersonal and relationship\-building skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, including competitor and market analysis.
* Willingness to travel extensively to customer locations across India and abroad.
* Experience with CRM tools and sales management platforms.
* A technical mindset with the ability to bridge engineering and customer requirements.

  


#### **Employee status and commitments**


* Permanent full\-time position located at our Bangalore office, with regular on\-site visits to clients and vendor locations.
* Overtime may be necessary to ensure the timely delivery of client projects.
* Weekend work is uncommon but may occasionally be required.

  


#### **Why join US?**


* **Culture of Excellence:** We are committed to fostering a culture where every individual can thrive, grow, and make a difference.
* **Opportunities for Growth:** We believe in investing in our people and providing opportunities for professional development and advancement.

* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work in cross\-functional teams.

* Opportunity to work on advanced Defence and Aerospace signal processing systems.

description:
**Company Description**

The Customer Support Executive (CSE) is responsible for delivering timely, accurate, and professional customer support through voice and chat channels for U.S.\-based customers. * Be flexible to work extended hours during high\-volume periods, when required
* Perform additional tasks as assigned in line with business needs

**A. Technical / Functional Skills**

* Experience in Customer Support / Contact Center / Voice or Chat Process
* Ability to troubleshoot and resolve customer queries effectively
* Experience handling service metrics and adherence to SLAs

**B. Soft Skills**

* Customer\-focused mindset with strong problem\-solving skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills (English)
* Self\-motivated and ability to work with minimal supervision
* Ability to remain calm and composed in high\-pressure situations
* Strong attention to detail and ownership of tasks

**Good to Have Skills**

* Prior experience in US voice support
* Exposure to CRM or ticketing tools
* Experience working in global support environments

 **Qualifications*** Graduate in any discipline
* Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of formal education

 **Additional Information*** 5 working days per week
* 2 rotational weekly offs (not necessarily Saturday/Sunday)
* Willingness to work US time zones / rotational shifts
* Flexibility to extend working hours during business peak periods

Take action as directed by Manager on HRMS requirements/activities. Responsible for ensuring the security and confidentiality of sensitive data. This covers data such as absence, turnover, grades, and job evaluation/salary/bonus figures. Ensure provisions of the Data Protection Act are followed. Configuring data and creating, maintaining and updating report specifications / templates. To maintain healthy employee relations and continually support users and various stakeholders on the use of HR Systems.
* **EMPLOYEE LIFE CYCLE:** Regularly validate and audit employee files. Collate data for regular statistical reports on HR information by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data. Provide basic advice on the policies and procedures to employees and managers. Submit monthly payroll inputs as per management instructions and employee requests. Complete Employee Life Cycle Management from hire to retire. Support on HR Systems (Workday) for business and HR processes.
* **Tier 2 Support:** Handle employee queries related to people services process through the Tier 2 process. Assist with the planning, implementation, maintenance and documentation of all the Tier 2 process. Work within our ticketing system (OneSupport) to create detailed work logs and article documentation. Manage OneSupport tickets in a timely manner and ensure the SLA are followed. Prepare weekly dashboards and provide executive summary on weekly basis to the LT team. Work closely with the Tier 3 team and provide guidance whenever needed.

Provides consistent and effective communication regarding employee’s status and on/offboarding process. Closely monitors and ensuring the on/offboarding checklist are closed by respective stakeholders. Attends to all queries and concerns pertaining to the on/offboarding process. Assist with global initiatives pertaining to offboarding.

**About you:**

* **Experience:** 5\-7 years of experience in BGV, Offer Management, Employee Lifecycle and On/Offboarding process. Graduate / Post graduate qualification in HR
* **Functional skills:** Knowledge of the latest tools and techniques in Human Resources. Demonstrate a good knowledge and understanding of HR Operations. Strong interpersonal skills.
* **Technical skills**: Must have experience in ticketing tools like One Support, ServiceNow. Should have experience in Workday applications. Proficient in MS Office (e.g. Word, Power point \& Excel)
* **Languages**: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Why choose us?**

* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future\-focused team.

title: Employee Relations Partner
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.


Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.


Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.


**About The Team And The Role:**


The People Experience \- Employee Relations Partner is responsible for supporting functional, jurisdictional and subject matter expertise within the area of Employee Relations, counseling managers and employees, and providing coaching, mentorship and guidance to Leaders and Employees on a broad range of complex and sensitive issues.


The ER Partner serves as a critical issue point and works closely with People Business Partners, Legal and other COEs such as Reporting, Comp \& Benefits, and Talent Acquisition and may also be responsible for external Vendor Management. They are a key contributor in streamlining and standardising HR policies and practices!


**What You Will Accomplish:**


* Provides mentorship and coaching to the People Team and/or to managers regarding the interpretation of policies and programs, employment legislation, compliance and operational efficiencies and improvements; manages consultant workload to performance metrics for their jurisdiction; provides specialist expertise and jurisdictionally appropriate legal advice and interpretation on employment legislation for critical and/or complex cases.
* Conducts investigations for increased and/or complex employee relations complaints, grievances and ethics notices (e.g., discrimination, harassment, retaliation)
* Builds and maintains strong, trust\-based relationships with key partners at all levels of the business and collaborates with PBPs, Legal, COEs and external vendors.
* Manages escalations related to external dependencies, bodies and vendors (e.g., record management, disability management, unemployment, labour authorities and government bodies)
* Responsible for building and delivering training to business leaders across the organisation. Also handle onboarding for new People Experience team members. Lead projects related to policy development, implementation, and operational improvements.
* Manages Statutory Labor Compliance for India.

**What You Will Bring:**


* Knowledge and understanding of employment legislation, its interpretation and implementation, and of employment practices in India
* Proficiency in HR which they can demonstrate to independently mitigate business, reputational and financial risk
* Leading and participating in large projects
* Passionate about coaching and developing manager capabilities
* Experience at using effective listening, probing and investigatory skills to handle complex, sensitive enquiries and conversations with discretion, composure and compassion
* Analytical attitude, able troubleshooter adept at analysing large amounts of detailed information, diagnosing problems and recommending appropriate solutions to senior business leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-paced, multi\-cultural, global organisation and to build strong trust\-based relationships with remote client groups and colleagues
* Ability to deliver high levels of performance and service excellence while managing high volume workload in a collaborative team environment
* Experience in preparation and delivery of presentations/training to managers.

**Experience:**


* 8 or more years in area of Human Resources in a global organisation
* 6 years or more, Employee Relations: jurisdictional or functional expertise
* Experience working with remote teams preferred

**Educational Requirements:**


* HR Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
* Qualification in Employment Law
* Higher certification in Human Resource Management

**Additional Details**


eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

  

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

ILSC\-New Delhi is seeking qualified and dynamic French Teachers available for teaching, between the hours of 10am and 5pm, Monday through Friday or weekend shifts, between the hours of 10am and 5pm.

  

Successful candidates will be comfortable teaching a diverse range of adult French Language programs and courses. A DELF qualification is essential.

The duties of this position include, but are not limited to:


* Teaches lesson(s) prepared by the classroom teacher utilizing various materials and technologies as required.
* Leaves details for the teacher if covering a class to support a smooth transition back to the classroom teacher.
* Maintains current and accurate class records.
* Maintains attendance records daily.
* Enforce French Only Policy.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

  


**Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Attributes:**


* Bachelor’s degree from a recognised university
* A recognized French teaching qualification (DELF, TEF, etc)
* Ability to communicate fluently and accurately in written and oral French
* Demonstrated proficiency with current technology tools and online learning platforms including:
	+ Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Outlook, Teams, SharePoint and Excel
	+ Zoom and Teams in a classroom setting
* Online and hybrid teaching experience preferred
* Deals effectively and courteously with students and staff, who may come from differing cultural and linguistic backgrounds.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize, organize and complete tasks with minimal supervision.

  


**Contact Information:**



While we thank all applications, only applicants who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

 **About ELS, ILSC \& Greystone College**  

  



A world leader in language education \& vocational training, ILSC Education Group, which opened its first language school in Vancouver, Canada in 1991 and Greystone College in 2002, offers life\-changing educational experiences in Canada, Australia, and India, some of the world’s most attractive and popular English\-speaking work and study destinations. Since opening its first school in Vancouver, BC, Canada, ILSC has become a world leader in language and career training and has grown to include 8 incredible locations around the world, in Vancouver, Toronto and Montréal, Canada; New Delhi, India; and Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne, and Adelaide, Australia.

  

In early 2022, ILSC Education Group joined forces with ELS Education Services, bringing together over 100 years of combined experience delivering life\-changing learning experiences to international students. Since 1961, when ELS Educational Services opened its first school in Washington DC, ELS has developed a global reputation for delivering top\-quality English language programs. ELS now has the most extensive network of on\-campus English language programs and University partners, across the USA.

  

Our mission is to provide our global community with transformative learning, living and work experiences by offering the finest language, career and higher education programs.

**PASSION:** To enrich \& transform people’s lives

 **INNOVATION:** To evolve through creativity \& diversity.

 **COLLABORATION:** To build community \& achieve more together

 **INTEGRITY:** To act responsibly \& ethically in everything we do

  

ELS, ILSC and Greystone College are committed to providing a barrier\-free environment and are proud to be Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employers. Relationship Building
  
Problem Solving
  
Change Management
  
Decision Making
  
Resilience

Essential

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 12 years of experience as an HR business partner or HR generalist supporting leaders at global companies.
* 4 years of experience in people management.
* Experience in organizational effectiveness, including workforce planning and organizational design.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Knowledge of initiating, planning, executing, controlling, and closing the work of a team to achieve specific goals and meet specific success criteria.
* Knowledge of the full talent management process across recruiting, hiring, mobility, and development.
* Knowledge of the skills and capabilities needed to lead work, develop people, and build community.
* Ability to act as a liaison or intermediary between employees and managers.
* Ability to communicate across audiences, situations, and contexts in both a written and verbal format.

**About the job**
-----------------


People Operations strives to revolutionize human resources the same way that Google has revolutionized search. We are helping to find, grow and keep the remarkable assemblage of talent who are our Googlers. You'll be an advocate of Google's culture and values, partnering with our business leaders to help them build their organizations and make sure all people decisions are based on data. Whether coaching our clients on how to lead their teams, navigating and resolving employee relations issues or managing programs that help develop our Googlers, you are exceptionally focused on putting them first, and being as clear and transparent as possible to help Googlers understand how people decisions get made.



Great just isn't good enough for our People Operations team (known elsewhere as "Human Resources"). We bring the world's most innovative people to Google and provide the programs that help them thrive. Whether recruiting the next Googler, refining our core programs, developing talent, or simply looking for ways to inject some more fun into the lives of our Googlers, we bring a data\-driven approach that is reinventing the human resources field.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Prepare leaders and teams to embrace organizational change, shaping and executing comprehensive people plans.
* Manage clear communication of people strategies and implement organizational changes to achieve desired business goals.
* Translate company\-wide OKRs into plans tailored to the specific needs of the client organization, providing feedback to identify potential gaps.
* Identify talent gaps, organizational shortcomings, and people needs that could hinder business strategy execution; use this analysis to guide resourcing and development initiatives.
* Deliver business impact for Google by setting, communicating, and achieving team priorities that support organizational goals. Align with partners and make key decisions as needed to achieve team objectives.

title: HR Manager
description:
**HR Manager – Job Description**
--------------------------------


**Industry:** Construction / Infrastructure  

**Experience:** 7\+ years, preferably in construction, infrastructure, EPC, or contracting companies.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Manage end\-to\-end HR operations for the corporate office, project sites, and other business units.
* Develop, implement, and regularly review HR policies, procedures, and employee guidelines in line with company requirements and applicable labour laws.
* Handle manpower planning in coordination with Project Managers and Department Heads based on project schedules and workforce requirements.
* Manage the complete recruitment cycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, salary negotiation, offer issuance, onboarding, and deployment to project sites.
* Ensure timely recruitment of engineers, project management professionals, commercial staff, finance personnel, administrative staff, skilled workers, and other site\-based employees.
* Monitor employee attendance, leave, late arrivals, absenteeism, overtime, site transfers, and biometric/mobile punching systems.
* Coordinate monthly payroll processing and verify attendance, leave, salary revisions, incentives, deductions, advances, reimbursements, and final settlements.
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory requirements, including EPF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, BOCW requirements, Contract Labour regulations, and other applicable labour laws.
* Coordinate with labour consultants, government departments, inspectors, and legal advisors for statutory filings, inspections, notices, and compliance matters.
* Maintain statutory registers, employee records, personnel files, employment contracts, appointment letters, confirmation letters, transfer letters, increment letters, warning letters, and other HR documentation.
* Manage employee relations and address grievances, disciplinary issues, misconduct, absenteeism, workplace conflicts, and performance\-related concerns.
* Conduct disciplinary enquiries and coordinate warning, suspension, termination, or other corrective actions in accordance with company policy and applicable law.
* Visit project sites periodically to review HR practices, employee welfare, attendance discipline, accommodation conditions, and site\-level manpower issues.
* Coordinate the mobilisation and demobilisation of employees and workers based on project requirements.
* Monitor employee performance and coordinate probation reviews, confirmations, appraisals, promotions, increments, and performance improvement plans.
* Develop retention strategies for critical positions and support succession planning for key project and functional roles.
* Identify training requirements in coordination with Department Heads and arrange technical, behavioural, safety, and compliance\-related training programmes.
* Manage employee engagement initiatives, welfare activities, company events, and internal communication programmes.
* Prepare and analyse HR MIS reports covering manpower strength, vacancies, recruitment status, attrition, absenteeism, payroll cost, overtime, and other HR metrics.
* Monitor manpower cost against project budgets and support management in workforce optimisation and cost\-control initiatives.
* Coordinate employee transfers between projects, departments, group companies, and business units as required.
* Manage resignations, notice periods, exit interviews, clearance processes, full and final settlements, and issuance of relieving and experience certificates.
* Support management in organisational restructuring, manpower rationalisation, salary benchmarking, and compensation planning.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee records, payroll information, disciplinary matters, and other sensitive HR data.
* Lead and guide the HR team, assign responsibilities, monitor performance, and ensure timely completion of HR activities.
* Report regularly to senior management on manpower status, recruitment progress, employee relations issues, statutory compliance, and key HR risks.

### **Preferred Qualification \& Skills**


* MBA / Master’s Degree in Human Resources Management or a related discipline.
* 7\+ years of progressive HR experience, with strong exposure to the construction, infrastructure, EPC, or contracting sector preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws and construction\-industry statutory compliance.
* Experience in multi\-site HR operations and handling project\-based manpower.
* Strong recruitment capability for technical, managerial, commercial, and site\-based positions.
* Sound knowledge of payroll, attendance management, HRMS, performance management, and HR analytics.
* Strong communication, negotiation, conflict\-resolution, and leadership skills.
* Ability to travel to project sites and manage HR matters across multiple locations.

description:
We are a global specialist engineering company that creates breakthrough solutions. We are curious and like to solve problems, partnering with our customers to solve the demands of today and prepare for the challenges of tomorrow. We embrace innovation and care about outcomes that are good for business, everyday life and making a better world \- creating lasting impact for everyone.
 



 We design, build and service highly engineered products in fluid and motion control applications. We focus on five market sectors: Industrial Automation, Process Automation, Climate Control, Life Science and Fluid Control,
 



 and Transport.
 



 Process Automation is a world leading provider of flow control solutions for critical applications across the Energy, Marine and Pharmaceutical markets.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 The HR Generalist will serve as a key member of the Business Unit HR team, providing comprehensive HR support across the employee lifecycle while partnering with managers and employees to drive business and people objectives. The role is responsible for executing core HR processes, ensuring compliance with company policies and statutory requirements, fostering employee engagement, and supporting organizational effectiveness initiatives. As an individual contributor, the incumbent will work closely with the BU HR Lead and business stakeholders to deliver a high\-quality HR service that supports business growth and employee experience.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**HR Business Support** 



* Partner with line managers and employees to provide day\-to\-day HR support and guidance on people\-related matters.
* Support the implementation of HR initiatives aligned with business objectives and workforce requirements.
* Assist managers in addressing employee concerns, performance issues, and organizational challenges.



  





**Learning \& Development** 




  




* Partner with functional managers to identify capability gaps and training needs aligned with business objectives.
* Coordinate the annual learning and development plan and ensure effective deployment of technical, behavioural, leadership, and compliance training programs.
* Facilitate employee development initiatives, including Individual Development Plans (IDPs), succession development actions, and competency enhancement programs.
* Monitor training effectiveness, completion rates, and learning outcomes, and provide periodic reports and insights to management.



  





**HR Operations** 




  




* Manage employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, confirmations, transfers, promotions, and separations.
* Ensure accurate maintenance of employee records, HR documentation, and HRIS data.
* Timely resolution of employee queries.



  





**Talent Acquisition Support** 




  




* Coordinate recruitment activities, including interview scheduling, candidate communication, and onboarding processes.
* Partner with hiring managers and the Talent Acquisition team to support timely closure of open positions.
* Facilitate induction and integration of new employees.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Human Resources, BusinessAdministration, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 8 years of progressive HR experience, preferably within manufacturing, engineering, industrial, or multinational organizations.
* Strong exposure to Employee Relations,HR operations, Recruitment and Training.
* Sound knowledge of HR best practices.
* Proficiency in HRIS platforms and Microsoft Office applications.



  





**Key Competencies** 




  




* HR Operations Excellence
* Employee Relations
* Performance \& Talent Management
* Stakeholder Management
* HR Compliance \& Governance
* Communication \& Interpersonal Skills
* Problem Solving\& Decision Making
* Data Analysis\& Reporting
* Planning \& Execution
* Continuous Improvement Orientation

title: HR Manager – Aleido India - Bengaluru – Hybrid
description:
**About the Role** 




 As HR Manager, you will lead the people function for Aleido India, supporting a growing team while ensuring our global HR strategy is effectively adapted to local business needs.
 



 You will be part of Aleido's global HR network, working closely with HR colleagues across our international markets. While many of our systems and processes—including our HRIS, recruitment platform, and employee engagement tools—are globally managed, you will be responsible for translating these into effective local practices that support our employees and business objectives in India.
 



 This is a broad generalist role combining strategic HR partnership with hands\-on execution. You are someone who builds trust quickly, thrives in ambiguity, and takes genuine pride in creating structure where there isn't any yet.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Partner with business leaders to develop and implement people strategies that support business growth.
* Own the complete employee lifecycle, including onboarding, performance management, employee development, engagement, and offboarding.
* Drive recruitment activities in partnership with hiring managers and build a strong employer brand.
* Implement and continuously improve scalable HR policies, processes, and best practices.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and high\-performance culture aligned with Aleido's values.
* Support managers with coaching, employee relations, performance conversations, and people development.
* Ensure compliance with Indian labour laws and employment regulations.
* Manage HR operations including HR systems, employee records, documentation, and reporting.
* Lead employee engagement initiatives, surveys, and action planning.
* Collaborate with the Global HR team to implement group\-wide HR initiatives while ensuring local relevance and compliance.
* Coordinate with external specialists and consultants for payroll, statutory compliance, legal matters, and other areas requiring expert support.
* Use people data and insights to recommend improvements and support informed business decisions.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources
* HR certifications such as SHRM are an advantage but not essential.
* 6–10 years of progressive HR experience, preferably in technology, engineering, consulting, or other knowledge\-based industries.
* Experience supporting a growing or scaling organization.
* Strong understanding of Indian employment legislation and HR best practices.
* Experience partnering with senior leaders and advising managers on people matters.
* Comfortable balancing strategic thinking with day\-to\-day operational execution.
* Experience working with HRIS and recruitment platforms.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* A proactive, hands\-on approach with the ability to work independently and build structure where needed.



  





**Why Join Aleido?** 



* Be part of an international organization with colleagues across multiple countries.
* Shape the people agenda for a rapidly growing India business.
* Work closely with both local leadership and the global HR team.
* Build scalable people practices that will influence the company's future growth.
* Enjoy a collaborative, learning\-oriented culture where people and innovation are equally valued.



  





**About Aleido India** 




 Aleido is a global leader in technical documentation, digital learning, and aftermarket information solutions. As our India business continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced HR Manager who will help build a high\-performing, people\-first organization while aligning local initiatives with our global HR strategy.
 



  





 This is not a transactional HR administrator role. It is a hands\-on leadership position for someone who enjoys building processes, partnering with business leaders, and creating an outstanding employee experience in a fast\-growing organization.

title: Lead Learning & Development Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


The Learning Business Partner (LBP) acts as the strategic interface between the business and the Learning \& Workforce (LVW) organization. The role ensures that learning priorities are aligned with business objectives, global frameworks, and compliance requirements. LBPs drive collaboration, governance, and insights to enable capability building across their span of control.


She/He acts as an account manager for Learning, responsible for defining and delivering learning priorities, managing stakeholder relationships, and ensuring end\-to\-end accountability for learning programs across portfolios, professional groups, and business units.


Stakeholder Ecosystem:


* Internal: Business Leaders, HR Business Partners, Talent Managers, Global Learning Delivery teams, Country Learning Delivery teams.


* External: Vendors (as needed for insights, not for delivery).


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Define and deliver learning priorities and targets across groups, global business lines (GBLs), strategic business units (SBUs), and countries.
* Hold end\-to\-end accountability for achieving learning priorities.
* Manage governance of learning topics, including stakeholder engagement and representation in organizational committees (OCIs).
* Align and collaborate with professional groups, business leads, and HR teams to cascade learning offers and key messages.
* Consolidate and challenge capability plans at global, group, and country levels to ensure business priorities are addressed.

* Manage stakeholder relationships with business owners, heads of learning, HR, and other key partners, reporting insights and achievements.
* Coordinate the development of learning programs, ensuring global alignment and collaboration across the learning value wheel (LVW).
* Own the quality and accuracy of learning data within scope, ensuring reliable reporting and insights.
* Oversee solutions deployment, maintaining an overarching view of all programs and promoting LVW\-agnostic solutions and frameworks (e.g., simplification, learning culture).
* Global only: Own skills governance, including the definition, learning, and alignment of skills with business and career needs.
**Roles and Responsibilities**
------------------------------


* 15\+ years of experience in Learning \& Development or HR, with exposure to global programs and governance.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience in learning governance and program management.
* Ability to manage budgets and validate compliance requirements.
* Analytical mindset for data accuracy and reporting.
* Knowledge of global learning frameworks and organizational committees

title: Junior IT Security Analyst (GRC)
description:
**Job Overview**

**\# ONLY AGNIVEERS SHOULD APPLY.**

Fourth Command is looking for a Junior IT Security Analyst (GRC) to join its team in a full\-time role focused on governance, risk, and compliance activities. This position is ideal for a fresher or early\-career candidate who wants to build a career in cybersecurity with practical exposure to GRC platform management, risk assessment, standards mapping, workflow support, API integration coordination, and security documentation.

The selected candidate will support day\-to\-day GRC operations by helping manage platform activities, organizing compliance and risk\-related information, assisting in workflow configuration, supporting documentation, and working with internal stakeholders on security and governance requirements. GRC roles commonly act as the bridge between business processes and security requirements by helping organizations manage risk, maintain compliance, and improve governance practices.

This role is best suited for someone who has a strong interest in cybersecurity governance, attention to detail, and the willingness to learn how security standards, policies, controls, and technology platforms work together in an organizational environment. The role also requires a basic technical mindset, including familiarity with coding concepts and support for platform\-related integrations and process automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the day\-to\-day management and administration of GRC platforms, including maintaining records, updating entries, supporting modules, and helping users navigate platform\-related tasks.
* Assist in conducting risk assessments by identifying risks, documenting observations, tracking remediation items, and supporting the preparation of risk registers and related reports.
* Help map security controls, policies, and internal processes against applicable cybersecurity standards and frameworks.
* Support the documentation and maintenance of major global cybersecurity standards and compliance requirements relevant to the organization, such as:
* ISO/IEC 27001
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework (NIST CSF)
* SOC 2
* PCI DSS
* GDPR
* HIPAA
* CIS Controls
* Assist with API integration\-related coordination for GRC or related platforms by supporting technical discussions, documenting integration requirements, validating data flow expectations, and working with technical teams where needed.
* Support workflow creation, updates, testing, and monitoring within the platform to improve process efficiency and task tracking.
* Provide platform support to internal users by helping troubleshoot basic issues, following up on platform tasks, and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day usage.
* Prepare, maintain, and organize GRC\-related documentation, including policies, procedures, process notes, evidence records, user guides, control documentation, and audit support material.
* Assist with audit and assessment readiness activities by organizing evidence, maintaining repositories, and supporting follow\-up actions on observations and findings.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure risks, controls, workflow requirements, and documentation needs are properly tracked and updated.
* Support ongoing improvement of governance and compliance processes through structured reporting, documentation quality, and process discipline.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* Fresher candidates can apply.
* Bachelor’s degree required in:
* BSc (IT)
* BSc (Cyber Security)
* BSc (Computer Science)
* BCA
* Candidate must have a minimum academic qualification of above 7\.0 CGPA in their qualifying degree.
* Good understanding or academic exposure to cybersecurity, information security, governance, risk, or compliance concepts is preferred.
* Basic awareness of major global cybersecurity standards and frameworks is required, especially ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GDPR, HIPAA, and CIS Controls.
* Understanding of risk assessment concepts, control documentation, and process\-based security work is preferred.
* Basic knowledge of GRC platforms, compliance tools, ticketing systems, or workflow\-based platforms will be an advantage.
* Basic coding knowledge is required, with familiarity in technologies such as Python, React, Node.js, or similar tools useful for platform support, automation, integrations, and technical coordination.
* Understanding of APIs, system integration basics, and data flow concepts will be beneficial for this role.
* Good documentation skills are essential, as the role involves preparing and maintaining process documents, policies, records, and support material.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills are important for working with internal teams and supporting compliance\-related coordination.
* Good analytical thinking, attention to detail, and willingness to learn are important for success in a GRC\-focused role.

**Working Model**

This is a full\-time role with Fourth Command and is suitable for candidates who are comfortable working in a structured professional environment with process\-driven responsibilities. The role may involve regular coordination with internal stakeholders, platform users, technical teams, and compliance\-related functions.

The position is best suited for candidates who are interested in long\-term growth in cybersecurity governance, risk management, compliance operations, and platform\-based security process management. Consistency, discipline, and comfort with documentation\-heavy and process\-oriented work will be important in this role.

**Mindset and Commitment**

Fourth Command is looking for a candidate who is sincere, detail\-oriented, and genuinely interested in building a career in cybersecurity with a governance and risk focus. Since this is a junior role, the company will value learning attitude, accountability, and willingness to work patiently on structured tasks such as documentation, risk tracking, platform updates, and workflow support.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, organized, and capable of balancing technical understanding with process discipline. A strong sense of ownership, professional communication, and readiness to learn both business and security requirements will be important for long\-term success in this role.

This position is well suited for someone who wants to grow in the GRC domain by gaining hands\-on exposure to cybersecurity standards, risk assessment, platform management, workflow support, integrations, and security documentation in a professional consulting environment.

title: Product Manager
description:
**The Role**

We are looking for a hungry, detail\-oriented **Business Analyst** to bridge the gap between our business operations and our engineering team.

You will start by owning the requirements for our internal operations ecosystem, designing **autonomous AI Agents** that assist sales, support, and operations. You will own the entire feature lifecycle—from the initial PRD using **BDD frameworks**, to delegating tasks to developers, and finally testing the delivery. As you master our internal systems, your role will expand into analyzing and scoping out brand\-new product features for our end\-users.

**What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)**

* **PRD Management (Using BDD):** Craft clear, concise Product Requirement Documents. We use **Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD)** to write requirements in the simplest possible words—breaking things down into clear **rules \& scenarios** (Given/When/Then) so everyone is aligned.
* **Scope AI \& Internal Tools:** Define requirements for our internal apps (e.g., Admin Panel) and AI initiatives:
* An *AI Sales Copilot* that automates user onboarding while salespeople monitor the flow.
* An *AI Support Quality Agent* that analyzes support calls to assist the Support Lead.
* An *AI Night\-Shift Support Agent* that handles customer queries autonomously after hours.
* **Requirement Delegation:** Hand over and explain requirements seamlessly to the Development Team, ensuring they clearly understand the business logic and edge cases before they start coding.
* **End\-to\-End Testing:** Act as the final gatekeeper. When the development team delivers a feature, you will test it against your BDD scenarios to ensure it works exactly as intended.
* **Product Evolution:** Transition into analyzing, benchmarking, and defining user\-facing product features as internal tooling milestones are achieved.

**Who You Are**

* **The Experience:** 1 to 2 years of experience as a BA, Product Analyst, or QA. **OR** a sharp fresher who can demonstrate a deep understanding of the BA lifecycle and has at least one solid internship under their belt.
* **The BDD Mindset:** You know how to communicate complex features using simple "rules and scenarios". Experience writing Gherkin/BDD syntax is a massive plus.
* **Full\-Lifecycle Ownership:** You aren't just a writer; you enjoy passing the baton to developers and rolling up your sleeves to test the final product.
* **AI Enthusiast:** You don't need to be a coder, but you must be fascinated by AI tools, ChatGPT/LLMs, and how agents can automate manual work.
* Preference will be given to local candidates only.

**Analytical Thinker:** You look at a messy manual process and immediately start drawing a mental flowchart on how to optimize it

title: Junior IT Security Analyst
description:
**Job Overview**

**\#ONLY AGNIVEERS SHOULD APPLY.**

Fourth Command is looking for a Junior IT Security Analyst for a technical cybersecurity role focused on supporting day\-to\-day security operations and helping protect client and internal environments from cyber threats. This role is suitable for a fresher or early\-career candidate who wants to build hands\-on experience in areas such as security monitoring, alert triage, vulnerability management, incident response support, endpoint security, network security, and technical documentation.

The selected candidate will work with the security team to monitor security tools, review alerts, support investigations, assist with vulnerability identification and remediation tracking, and help maintain the effectiveness of security controls across systems and platforms. Junior security analysts commonly support the front\-line technical work of identifying suspicious activity, analyzing security events, and helping improve an organization’s defensive posture.

This role is best suited for a candidate with a strong technical interest in cybersecurity, a willingness to learn hands\-on tools and processes, and a disciplined approach to analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation. The position also requires basic understanding of operating systems, networking, security tools, and coding or scripting concepts that can support automation and operational tasks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor security alerts and events generated by security tools such as SIEM, XDR, antivirus, endpoint protection, IDS/IPS, firewall logs, or related monitoring platforms, and support initial triage of suspicious activities.
* Assist in identifying, analyzing, and escalating security incidents based on severity, impact, and available evidence.
* Support incident response activities by collecting basic information, documenting observations, creating tickets, tracking actions, and coordinating with senior analysts or technical teams during investigations.
* Perform or support vulnerability assessment activities, including reviewing scan results, validating findings, tracking remediation progress, and maintaining vulnerability records.
* Assist in the configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of technical security tools and controls used across endpoint, network, server, cloud, or application environments.
* Review logs, alerts, and system behavior to help identify anomalies, suspicious patterns, or indicators of compromise.
* Support endpoint and system security activities such as patch follow\-up, antivirus status checks, system hardening coordination, access reviews, and compliance with basic security baselines.
* Work with internal teams to raise, track, and follow up on security issues, remediation actions, and operational tasks related to threats, vulnerabilities, or system weaknesses.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation such as incident notes, vulnerability trackers, asset observations, investigation records, standard operating procedures, and security support documents.
* Stay updated on emerging cyber threats, attacker techniques, common vulnerabilities, and security technologies relevant to operational defense and monitoring.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* Fresher candidates can apply for this role.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred in:
* BSc (IT)
* BSc (Cyber Security)
* BSc (Computer Science)
* BCA
* Or other related technical backgrounds aligned to information security and systems support.
* Candidate must have a minimum academic qualification of above 7\.0 CGPA in their qualifying degree.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts such as threats, vulnerabilities, malware, phishing, endpoint security, network security, and incident handling is required.
* Familiarity with technical security domains such as SIEM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, firewall basics, antivirus, log analysis, or IDS/IPS will be an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of networking concepts such as IP addressing, ports, protocols, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, VPN, and firewalls is important for this role.
* Basic understanding of Windows, Linux, endpoints, user access, and system\-level security controls is preferred.
* Basic coding or scripting knowledge is required, with familiarity in Python, PowerShell, Bash, Node.js, React, or related technologies being useful for automation, tool support, integrations, and technical troubleshooting.
* Awareness of vulnerability scanning, remediation tracking, and technical issue documentation will be beneficial.
* Good analytical thinking, troubleshooting ability, and attention to detail are important for monitoring and incident support work.
* Good written and verbal communication skills are required for documentation, reporting, and coordination with technical teams.

**Working Model**

This is a full\-time technical cybersecurity role with Fourth Command and is suitable for candidates who are comfortable working in a structured operational environment. The role may require continuous coordination with internal security teams, technical teams, and project stakeholders for monitoring, investigation support, remediation follow\-up, and security operations activities.

The position is ideal for candidates who want practical exposure to technical cybersecurity work and are interested in building long\-term careers in security operations, threat monitoring, vulnerability management, detection engineering support, or incident response. The role demands consistency, focus, and readiness to learn tools, processes, and technologies used in real\-world cyber defense environments.

**Mindset and Commitment**

Fourth Command is looking for a candidate who is technically curious, disciplined, and committed to learning cybersecurity through hands\-on operational work. Since this is a junior role, the company will value sincerity, willingness to learn, strong observation skills, and the ability to follow structured security processes carefully and responsibly.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, alert, and comfortable working with logs, alerts, systems, and technical observations. A strong sense of ownership, timely escalation, professional communication, and a genuine interest in technical cybersecurity will be important for success in this role.

title: Web App Development Intern (Full Stack: Next.js & AI-Assisted)
description:
Department Web Engineering
  

Employment Type Internship
  

Duration 3 to 6 Months
  

Location Pune, India (On\-site)
  

Stipend **Performance\-based**
  

Qualification **Preferred:** B.E. / B.Tech (CS, IT, or related)
  

**Also acceptable:** MCA, B.Sc. (CS/IT) with a strong deployed portfolio
  

Mandatory Must HaveNext.js proficiency \+ Active use of AI coding tools (Claude / Claude Code)
  

Preferred Candidate Freshers or recent graduates with a strong interest in building and deploying full\-stack web applications, comfortable with Next.js. The ideal candidate writes clean, working code, understands the basics of deployment and version control, and actively uses Claude or Claude Code in their day\-to\-day workflow to move faster and write better code. Strong JavaScript fundamentals, attention to UI detail, and a habit of shipping complete work are what we value most at this level. A portfolio of live, deployed projects is more meaningful than certifications alone.
  

**About MagicWorks**
--------------------


MagicWorks IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a Pune\-based AI\-first digital marketing agency that turns traffic, leads, and operations into predictable revenue. With 17\+ years of experience, a team of 30\+ experts, and a 98% client satisfaction rate, we help businesses across Education, Manufacturing, Real Estate, Travel, Hospitality, and more achieve measurable growth.


**Job Summary**
---------------


We are looking for a Web App Development Intern with strong React fundamentals and an active habit of using AI coding tools such as Claude or Claude Code. This is a full\-time, on\-site internship in Pune for candidates who are comfortable with Next.js or eager to learn it on the job, and who write clean, working code. You will assist in building and maintaining client websites, convert Figma designs into responsive components, integrate APIs and CMS content, and participate in sprint reviews. A portfolio of live, deployed projects carries more weight than certifications alone.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


Assist in building and maintaining client websites using Next.js and React
Convert Figma designs into responsive HTML/CSS and React components, under guidance
Write clean, readable JavaScript/TypeScript code following team conventions
Help integrate third\-party APIs, CMS content, and analytics into Next.js projects
Support testing, debugging, and fixing bugs across live and in\-progress client builds
Learn to use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor as part of your daily workflow
Get hands\-on exposure to headless CMS setups and AI\-native features wired into a site
Participate in sprint stand\-ups, code reviews, and team discussions
Take ownership of small, well\-defined tasks from start to finish with senior developer support
**Required Skills**
-------------------


* Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript ES6\+ fundamentals
* Some exposure to React through coursework, a bootcamp, personal projects, or self\-study
* Basic familiarity with Git and version control workflows
* Comfortable reading and following existing code rather than writing only from a blank file
* Genuine willingness to learn Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend tooling on the job
* Curiosity about how AI coding tools fit into a real development workflow
* Basic understanding of responsive design and cross\-browser behaviour
* Good written and verbal communication in English
* Eagerness to ask questions, take feedback well, and iterate quickly
**Preferred Skills**
--------------------


* Any prior hands\-on exposure to Next.js, even at a tutorial or personal\-project level
* Familiarity with Tailwind CSS or any utility\-first styling approach
* Basic understanding of REST APIs and how front\-end code consumes them
* Personal projects involving a CMS, database, or third\-party API integration
* Active use of an AI coding assistant in college projects or personal work
* A GitHub profile, portfolio, or deployed personal project you can walk us through
* Awareness of basic SEO, accessibility, or web performance concepts
**What You Will Gain**
----------------------


**Full\-Stack Exposure**Hands\-on work with Next.js, React, APIs, and headless CMS on live client projects
**Stipend**Performance\-based stipend provided during internship
**AI\-First Workflow**Learn to use Claude Code and other AI coding assistants as a professional daily habit
**Mentorship**Direct guidance from senior developers with code reviews and sprint participation
**Internship Certificate**Official certificate upon successful completion
**Letter of Recommendation**Based on performance and contribution to shipped projects
**PPO Opportunity**Outstanding interns are considered for a Pre\-Placement Offer
**Portfolio Projects**Walk away with real, deployed work you can show in job applications
A GitHub profile, portfolio link, or any deployed project \- even a small one \- will carry more weight than academic credentials alone. Candidates who actively use AI coding tools and can demonstrate it will be preferred.

description:
More than a mission, C2FO is a better financial system changing the way every business gains access to the working capital they need to thrive. At C2FO, everyone is an employee\-owner which means we’re all invested in our work and team members. We’re a company of team players and self\-starters finding new and innovative ways to get things done. If you’re excited to learn, grow, and leave your mark on our fast\-growing organization, C2FO may be the place for you.
  
About C2FO
  
Headquartered in Kansas City, USA, C2FO has more than 500 employees worldwide, with operations throughout North America, Europe, India, Asia Pacific, and Australia. C2FO is the world’s largest on\-demand working capital platform. Our mission is to ensure every business has the capital needed to thrive and we have delivered more than $400\+ billion in funding to businesses since our founding. How do we do this? By providing fast, flexible, and equitable access to low\-cost capital through our easy\-to\-use platform.We provide technology with a human touch, giving our customers the direct support they need and ensuring our team members have the tools, resources, and work environment they need to deliver on our promise to customers. With the C2FO platform, businesses worldwide have more working capital to fuel their growth, create jobs and develop new products.
