title: Security Consulting Engineer
description:
Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.
   

  

 The Customer Engagement \& Experience role proactively collaborates across functions\-including Customer Success, Sales, Support, and product and engineering teams\-to ensure a unified customer experience throughout the lifecycle, effectively managing time, communications, and expectations. Acting as a technical liaison between customer environments and Cisco product teams, the role provides feedback to influence product evolution and ensure compatibility with real\-world use cases. In Solution Delivery \& Technical Execution, the role is responsible for designing, deploying, optimizing, migrating, and troubleshooting security solutions that extend or enhance Cisco products, enabling seamless integration with customer environments and third\-party systems. It serves as a focal point for proactive problem resolution, offers timely support across Cisco and third\-party technologies, applies deep knowledge of security frameworks, threat models, and regulatory standards to help customers build resilient, scalable, and policy\-aligned architectures, develops and reviews technical deliverables to support customer engagements and enable long\-term self\-sufficiency, and leverages AI and automation to enhance delivery efficiency, innovation, and customer outcomes. The role also develops vertical market expertise to better translate customer business needs into technical solutions, integrates Cisco and non\-Cisco security technologies in complex, multi\-vendor environments to ensure interoperability and policy alignment, and contributes to knowledge sharing and the development of security\-focused intellectual capital, including reusable assets, best practices, and compliance templates.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* In this role, you will work on intermediate security projects, including the implementation of basic controls and policy configurations.
* You will expand your understanding of a security domain and third\-party security product integrations, learning how these solutions align with customer environments.
* Your contributions will impact your team as well as related teams, often within a highly matrixed environment.
* As you engage with customers with increasing independence, you will begin to build and strengthen customer relationships.
* You will participate in customer meetings to understand their needs and map customer outcomes to project scope, aligning with the end\-to\-end plan where available.
* By developing a working understanding of customer security goals, risk posture, and compliance requirements, you will identify underutilized features and collate usage insights.
* Your ability to build relationships and develop trust will be reinforced through consistent follow\-through and collaboration with internal and partner teams.
* You will connect and communicate project activities to medium\-term customer outcomes such as functionality, scalability, and performance.
* With growing independence, you will develop project scopes aligned to customer security goals, leveraging AI and automation tools.
* You will apply a range of security consulting tools and techniques, such as risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and compliance mapping, to support planning and delivery.
* You will co\-develop deliverables and work to improve documentation quality.
* Serving as an initial focal point for implementation and migration issues, you will understand vulnerabilities and communicate proposed resolutions and rationales to customers.
* You will build and use test environments to resolve issues, following quality standards and frameworks such as ISO 9001 and ISO 27001\.
* Demonstrating a working knowledge of Cisco and other fundamental security technologies—including identity management, SIEM, and DLP—you will also exhibit intermediate skills in automation, scripting, and orchestration, along with a basic understanding of DevSecOps practices.
* You will provide updates to support knowledge transfer, explaining technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* By gathering lessons learned and best practices, you will help create and refine intellectual capital, contributing to a repository of best practices, modular reusable templates, and standardized materials for the team.
* You will apply AI tools to streamline routine tasks, freeing time for learning and higher\-impact work. Staying informed on automation, threat intelligence, compliance, and AI\-driven security tools and trends, you will validate AI outputs appropriately.
* An entry\-level security certification, such as Cisco CyberOps Associate or CompTIA Security\+, is required.
* You will apply foundational consulting and collaboration skills to communicate, manage expectations, and adapt plans as needed.
* Collaboration across internal teams—including Senior Customer Engineers (CEs), Cisco Account Teams, and Partners—will help you understand the range of solutions offered to customers.
* You will take ownership of team deliverables and build connections to solve problems, contributing to a unified customer experience. Additionally, you will begin mentoring junior or newer engineers in development tools and practices.


**Minimum Qualifications**
 Bachelors \+ 2 years of related experience, or
   

  

 Masters \+ 0 years of related experience,
   

  

 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Jr. Engineer - Security
description:
CBTS serves enterprise and midmarket clients in all industries across the United States and Canada. CBTS combines deep technical expertise with a full suite of flexible technology solutions\-\-including Application Modernization, Managed Hybrid Cloud, Cybersecurity, Unified Communications, and Infrastructure solutions. From developing and deploying modern applications and the secure, scalable platforms on which they run, to managing, monitoring, and optimizing their operations, CBTS delivers comprehensive technology solutions for its clients' transformative business initiatives. For more information, please visit www.cbts.com.
   

  

 OnX is a leading technology solution provider that serves businesses, healthcare organizations, and government agencies across Canada. OnX combines deep technical expertise with a full suite of flexible technology solutions—including Generative AI, Application Modernization, Managed Hybrid Cloud, Cybersecurity, Unified Communications, and Infrastructure solutions. From developing and deploying modern applications and the secure, scalable platforms on which they run, to managing, monitoring, and optimizing their operations, OnX delivers comprehensive technology solutions for its clients’ transformative business initiatives. For more information, please visit
 ****www.onx.com****
 .
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 As a Security Automation Engineer I, you will contribute to the growth and maturity of our Security Operations team by developing and maintaining automation playbooks and workflows within our SOAR and XDR platforms. You will be responsible for translating analyst\-driven investigation workflows into automation that accelerates triage, enrichment, containment, and remediation of issues across the SOC. A strong background in security operations is essential for this role. Understanding what happens before and after an alert is received is what separates functional automation from automation that reflects how real investigations work. By collaborating closely with SOC analysts and senior engineers, you will help reduce manual workload, improve response consistency, and support a more resilient security operation.
   

  

**Experience**
 2\+ years of experience as a SOC analyst, with senior analyst experience preferred. Candidates must demonstrate hands\-on familiarity with alert triage, threat investigation, and escalation decision\-making.
   

  

 1\-2 years of experience working with a SOAR platform, with Palo Alto XSIAM or XSOAR experience strongly preferred.
   

  

****Education****
 Four\-year college degree resulting in a bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience.
   

  

****Certifications, Accreditations, Licenses****
**One Or More Of The Following Certifications**
 Palo Alto Cortex, CompTIA Security\+, CompTIA CySA\+, GIAC GSEC, EC\-Council CEH, and similar.
   

  

****Special Knowledge****
 The ideal candidate has a solid understanding of cybersecurity principles, common attack techniques, and SOC operational workflows. Candidate will have experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, threat intelligence, endpoint protection, and email security technologies. Familiarity with SOAR playbook development is required, with Palo Alto XSIAM and/or XSOAR experience being strongly preferred. Candidates should understand common detection use cases including phishing, endpoint compromise, identity threats, and network anomalies.
   

  

 Proficiency in Python for scripting and automation tasks is required. Candidates must be comfortable working with REST APIs, Regex, and JSON to build and troubleshoot platform integrations. Familiarity with Windows, MacOS, and Linux environments is expected.
   

  

**Skills**
 Develop, test, and maintain automated playbooks and integrations across Palo Alto XSOAR and Cortex XSIAM. Collaborate with SOC analysts to identify manual, repetitive workflows and translate them into reliable automation. Experience integrating security tools and platforms to support cohesive, automated response workflows.
   

  

 Strong analytical skills to evaluate playbook performance, identify logic gaps, and iterate based on analyst feedback and operational data. Effective problem\-solving to troubleshoot integration and automation failures.
   

  

 Clear verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document playbook logic and contribute to design discussions across distributed teams.
   

  

**Abilities**
 Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and stay productive in a remote environment. Must be a collaborative team player capable of contributing to technical conversations and troubleshooting sessions. High attention to detail to ensure automation logic performs accurately under varied conditions.
   

  

 Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with evolving threats, detection techniques, and automation capabilities. Ability to adapt playbook logic as the threat landscape and tool stack change over time.
   

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
 No Supervisory Responsibility.

title: L2 Network Engineer
description:
**Introduction**
 At IBM Infrastructure \& Technology, we design and operate the systems that keep the world running. From high\-resiliency mainframes and hybrid cloud platforms to networking, automation, and site reliability. Our teams ensure the performance, security, and scalability that clients and industries depend on every day. Working in Infrastructure \& Technology means tackling complex challenges with curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies and colleagues worldwide to deliver resilient, future\-ready solutions that power innovation. With continuous learning, career growth, and a supportive culture, IBM provides the opportunities to build expertise and shape the infrastructure that drives progress.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Your role and responsibilities**
* Monitor and maintain network devices at DC/DR/NDR sites
* Handle network issues: ticketing, troubleshooting, and escalation
* Perform basic configuration changes as per SOPs
* Share daily reports on device health and network alerts
* Support L2 engineers with issue resolution
* Coordinate with DC teams and service providers
* Maintain network device inventory and architecture diagrams
* Participate in DR drills
* Perform basic cabling (crimping, routing, etc.)


**Requirements**
* Educational qualification \- Post graduate/Graduate/Diploma
* 5 years experience
* CCNP / JNCIP/ Equivalent SDWAN certification
* Basic knowledge of networking and devices (Cisco, Juniper)
* Understanding of troubleshooting and IT support
* Familiarity with data center or hybrid cloud environments


**Preferred**
* Knowledge of ITSM (incident/problem management)
* Exposure to support/monitoring tools


**Preferred Education**
 Associate's Degree/College Diploma
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Exposure to Networking Products: Familiarity with installation, maintenance, and repair of Networking products, such as Cisco, Juniper, and Teradata, including understanding of the technology, operating systems, and associated software.
* Experience Working with Technical Tools: Knowledge of IBM tools, such as Cognitive Support Platform (Salesforce) and Watson Einstein Analytics, to drive automation and improve effectiveness of client operations.
* Understanding of IT Engineering: Basic understanding of installation, customization, operation, recovery, tuning, and information technology engineering concepts.
* Familiarity with Hybrid Cloud Environments: Exposure to onsite Infrastructure Services, maintenance, and consultancy for Hybrid Cloud client environments.
* Basic Technical Troubleshooting: Ability to identify and resolve basic technical issues related to installation, update, configuration, operations, or performance of Networking products.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Familiarity with IT Service Management: Exposure to IT service management principles and practices, including problem management, incident management, and change management, is beneficial for this role.
* Knowledge of Cloud Computing: Understanding of cloud computing concepts, including infrastructure as a service (IaaS), platform as a service (PaaS), and software as a service (SaaS), can be advantageous in providing technical support for Hybrid Cloud client environments.
* Exposure to Data Analytics: Familiarity with data analytics tools and techniques, such as data visualization and predictive analytics, can be helpful in analyzing and resolving technical issues related to Networking products.

description:
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and a key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporate and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability
   

  

 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
   

  

 At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind, and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, color, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**Summary:**



 The Network Infrastructure Services Team is responsible for architecting, building, automating, and operating comapnys global network infrastructure across on\-premises data centers and all major public cloud providers. The team supports highly scalable, secure, and resilient connectivity for company’s development, SaaS, and enterprise platforms worldwide. As a Senior Network Engineer, you will work in a highly collaborative, fast\-paced environment, partnering with global infrastructure and platform teams to ensure network stability, performance, and security at scale.
 




**Responsibilities:**
* Manage and support network and security infrastructure across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI.
* Ensure availability, stability, and performance of on\-premises and cloud network environments.
* Monitor the network support queue, troubleshoot incidents, perform root\-cause analysis, and drive corrective actions.
* Support enterprise and cloud network architectures, including DC, campus, WAN, and hybrid connectivity.
* Collaborate with global teams to resolve critical issues and support ongoing infrastructure improvements.
* Participate in shift rotations to provide operational coverage.


**Requirements:**
* 6 years of hands\-on experience in network operations and implementation at enterprise scale (data center and/or public cloud).
* Strong experience with at least one public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI).


**Required Skills:**
* Solid understanding of enterprise network design, including Data Center, Campus Networks, Public Cloud Networking, and Global WAN connectivity.
* Strong knowledge of networking technologies: IPv4 / IPv6, BGP, VPN technologies, L2 Switching, and VXLAN.
* Hands\-on experience with multiple network vendors, including: Arista (L2/L3, CVP) \- required, Cisco (Spine\-Leaf, IOS, NX\-OS), Meraki (Wireless), and Palo Alto Networks (Firewalls).


**Preferred Skills:**
* Experience with load balancers, preferably Citrix NetScaler, AVI Load Balancer, NGINX, and HAProxy.
* Knowledge of network security and access control, including Palo Alto Firewalls, 802\.1X, Network Authentication Systems, and VPN technologies.
* Public Cloud Network Certifications (AWS / Azure / GCP).

* Fortinet NSE

description:
**Job Description**
**Family Description**
 Customer Services (CS) covers customer service in different areas such as technical support, account support, operations, maintenance, network design / deployment / integration / transformation, and education. Generates revenue and the increase of customer satisfaction through planning, designing, deploying, integrating, optimising, operating, and maintaining phases.
   

  

**Subfamily Description**
 Managed Services (MSE) is responsible for keeping the network running and proposing / conducting network upgrades based on business requirements. Covers technical managing and operating of agreed components of IT and telecommunications services provided to end users of Nokia customers, within contracts agreed with those customers.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Level 2 (L2\) support handling advanced monitoring, fault isolation, root\-cause analysis, and restoration. Identification of Key Technical Risks and Issues, develop mitigation plans.
* Preparation of MOP (Method of Procedure) covering Network Changes, Rollback, and Contingency.
* Review and validate network designs, configurations, and change plans before implementation.
* Provide technical guidance during critical network activities and major incidents.
* Ensure adherence to standard operating procedures and best practices during execution.
* Support post\-change validation and stability checks.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth implementation of network activities.
* Document technical findings, lessons learned, and improvement actions.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**You have:**
* Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Telecom or equivalent with 5 to 10 years of experience.
* Experience in designing and delivering solutions in IP\-MPLS MP\-BGP solutions: L2VPN, L3VPN.
* Hands\-on experience \& knowledge of Nokia Service Architecture.
* Detailed understanding of Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), Segment Routing, MP\-BGP EVPN concepts and related technologies
* Experience in designing and delivering solutions such as BNG.
* Knowledgeable on Network Management Systems, networking concepts and related technologies
* Excellent in designing E2E Mobile Networks, Backhaul and Core Solutions and Concepts.
* Experience with document preparation (HLD and LLD), including configuration preparation for network build \& deployment, troubleshooting, and fault isolation in live environments.


**It would be nice if you also had:**
* Experience with following hardware:
* Routing \& Switching: Cisco, HP, Arista FortiGate
* WIFI: Aruba, Cisco
* Firewall: Checkpoint, Cisco ASA, FortiGate, PaloAlto
* Application Delivery Controller: F5 LoadBalancer, Citrix NetScaler, Netskope, Radware
* SD\-WAN: FortiNet, Cisco Catalyst, VMWare Velocloud

title: Senior Network Engineer (R&S)
description:
**Responsibilities:**
* Responsible for the delivery of network planning, design, implementation \& optimization services as a post sales consultant to WWT's Commercial Enterprise clients.
* Create Low Level and High Level design of data center networks utilizing industry best practices and Cisco hardware to include: Cisco enterprise level L3 switching and Nexus 7K/5K/2K platforms
* Lead the delivery of network solutions including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers and other network hardware appliances.
* Oversee/perform new and existing equipment, hardware, and software upgrades.
* Perform installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of customer managed hardware, software, and peripheral devices.
* Monitor network performance and troubleshoot problem areas as needed.
* Conduct research on network products, services, protocols, and standards to remain abreast of developments in the networking industry.


 ,
   

  

**Requirements:**
* Must have at least 7 years of experience designing, deploying, and implementing core route/switch and/or data center networks in accordance with industry best practices
* Extensive Nexus 7K/5K/2K experience required.
* Experience logical design models (L2/L3, VPC, VDC, Datacenter Zones, Spanning tree, VFR, VTP, VLANs, physical cabling).
* Working technical knowledge of network control protocols (QOS, PfR, PoE, NTP, DHCP), network management protocols (CDP, FTP, TFTP, SNMP) and security protocols (SSH, HTTPS, AAA, IPSec, TustSec).
* Strong knowledge IP communication and routing is required (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP). Experience with inter\-company routing is preferred.
* Understand WAN/LAN and transport technologies (Ethernet, Frame Relay, DMVPN, WAAS and MPLS).
* Experience with network automation using Ansible or other orchestration tools.
* Configuration management of networking devices using automation tools (APIC\-EM, Cisco Prime) and API scripting with Python
* SDWAN Implementation experience required.
* Certifications in CCNP (active certification is must), CCIE R\&S and/or Data Center preferred.
* Knowledge or experience with Nexus 9K and ACI is a plus.
* Knowledge or experience with SDA is a plus.
* Knowledge or experience with Meraki is a plus.
* Knowledge or experience F5 load balancing, Palo Alto technologies, Cisco UCS, or Cisco MDS is a plus.
* Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills with the ability to work well in a collaborative environment.
* Able to conduct research into networking issues and products as required.
* Highly self\-motivated and directed, with keen attention to detail.
* Able to effectively prioritize tasks in a high\-pressure environment.
* Strong customer service orientation with proven analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Related degree in computer science or electrical engineering and/or seven to ten years equivalent network engineering experience.

title: Digital Assets Web3 Engineer - Vice President
description:
Discover your future at Citi
   

  

 Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 Citi is seeking a passionate and skilled
 **Digital Assets Web3 Engineer** 
 to join the Citi Integrated Digital Assets Platform (CIDAP) engineering team. This is a hands\-on engineering role for a developer who is deeply enthusiastic about the intersection of decentralized technologies and institutional finance.
   

  

 The successful candidate will contribute to the design, development, and deployment of Web3\-native components and integrations that power Citi's digital asset infrastructure — spanning tokenization, smart contracts, on\-chain settlement, and blockchain protocol integrations. You will work within a collaborative, globally distributed team of engineers, architects, and business technologists who are building the next generation of institutional digital finance capabilities.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who brings strong Web3 engineering fundamentals, a curiosity for emerging blockchain ecosystems, and the ability to bridge decentralized technology patterns with enterprise\-grade software standards.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, and deploy Web3 components and integrations for Citi's Digital Asset Platform, including smart contracts, on\-chain event listeners, wallet integrations, and blockchain protocol connectors
* Build and maintain backend services that interface with public and permissioned blockchain networks (e.g., Ethereum, Hyperledger Besu, Corda, or equivalent)
* Develop, test, and audit smart contracts written in Solidity or equivalent languages, ensuring security, correctness, and gas efficiency
* Integrate Web3 libraries and SDKs (e.g., Web3J, Web3JS, Ethers.js, Viem) into enterprise Java and/or Node.js backend services
* Implement asynchronous, event\-driven architectures to handle on\-chain events, transaction lifecycle management, and blockchain state synchronization
* Collaborate with architects and senior engineers to contribute to the design of scalable, secure, and resilient Web3 infrastructure
* Participate in code reviews, providing and receiving constructive technical feedback to maintain high engineering standards
* Support the integration of digital asset custody solutions, tokenization frameworks, and DeFi/TradFi bridging components
* Contribute to technical documentation, including smart contract specifications, integration guides, and architecture notes
* Stay current with the rapidly evolving Web3 ecosystem — tracking protocol upgrades, new token standards, Layer 2 solutions, and emerging tooling relevant to institutional use cases
* Work within Agile/Scrum frameworks, participating in sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives within a distributed global team
* Help identify and resolve technical issues across the Web3 stack, escalating where appropriate to ensure delivery quality and timelines


**Qualifications / Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; MS is a plus
* 5 to 8 years of overall software engineering experience, with a strong backend development foundation
* 2 to 4 years of hands\-on experience in Web3 and blockchain application development, including smart contract development and blockchain protocol integration
* 3 to 5 years of experience with backend development using Java/Spring, Node.js, or equivalent enterprise frameworks
* Proficiency in Solidity smart contract development, including testing frameworks (Hardhat, Foundry, Truffle) and security best practices
* Hands\-on experience with Web3 libraries such as Web3J, Web3JS, Ethers.js, or Viem
* Solid understanding of blockchain fundamentals — consensus mechanisms, transaction lifecycle, gas models, wallet infrastructure, and key management
* Experience with token standards (ERC\-20, ERC\-721, ERC\-1155, ERC\-3525, or equivalent) and tokenization patterns
* Familiarity with permissioned blockchain networks (Hyperledger Besu, Fabric, Corda, or R3\) is a strong plus
* Experience with asynchronous programming, event\-driven systems, and message queuing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines
* Understanding of cryptographic concepts — digital signatures, hashing, PKI, and secure key management — as applied to blockchain systems
* Exposure to Layer 2 scaling solutions (Polygon, Optimism, zkSync, etc.) and cross\-chain interoperability protocols is a plus
* Experience in financial services or regulated industries is a plus
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and distributed team collaboration tools


 Competencies / Skills
   

  

* Web3 Engineering Depth: Strong command of the Web3 technology stack — from smart contract development to on\-chain/off\-chain integration patterns and blockchain node interaction
* Backend Engineering Fundamentals: Solid grounding in enterprise software engineering — API design, microservices, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns
* Security Mindset: Awareness of common smart contract vulnerabilities (reentrancy, front\-running, integer overflow, etc.) and best practices for secure on\-chain development
* Curiosity \& Adaptability: Genuine enthusiasm for the Web3 ecosystem and the ability to rapidly learn and apply new protocols, standards, and tooling
* Collaborative Spirit: Strong team player who communicates clearly and constructively with engineers, architects, and non\-technical stakeholders
* Delivery Orientation: Ability to manage personal delivery commitments, prioritize effectively, and produce high\-quality output within sprint cycles
* Attention to Detail: Rigorous approach to testing, code quality, and documentation — particularly important given the immutable nature of on\-chain deployments
* Tooling Proficiency: Working knowledge of engineering tools including Git, Jira, Jenkins, Hardhat/Foundry, Docker, Helm, and observability platforms


 Development Value
   

  

 As a Digital Assets Web3 Engineer at Citi, you will be at the forefront of one of the most exciting and strategically significant technology domains in institutional finance. You will:
   

  

* Work on real\-world, production\-grade Web3 infrastructure at the scale and complexity of a global systemically important bank
* Gain deep exposure to institutional digital asset use cases — including tokenized securities, digital cash, on\-chain settlement, and programmable finance
* Collaborate with world\-class engineers, architects, and business leaders who are defining the future of digital finance at Citi
* Build expertise across both Web3\-native and enterprise technology stacks, making you a uniquely versatile engineer in a rapidly growing field
* Access continuous learning opportunities, including emerging protocol research, industry conferences, and internal innovation programs
* Contribute to a platform with global reach and real commercial impact, with visibility across Citi's technology and business leadership

title: Scrum Master
description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change.
   

  

  

  

 By combining world\-class engineering, industry expertise and a people\-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses.
   

  

  

  

 From prototype to real\-world impact \- be part of a global shift by doing work that matters.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Role Summary**




 Scrum Masters enable the implementation of scrum framework and its principles, values, and practices within a squad. The role acts as a servant leader who helps their teams to deliver value incrementally in a collaborative manner. They are aligned to one or two squads.
   

  





  

  





**Core Duties/Responsibilities**




 The successful candidate will be responsible for the following:
   

  

  




* Acts as a servant leader by serving the needs of the Scrum Team, removing obstacles, and empowering team members to take ownership of their work.
* Promotes continuous improvement by facilitating Sprint Retrospectives, identifying opportunities, and implementing action plans.
* Encourages reflection on processes and supports incremental changes.
* Continuously develops personal knowledge and skills by engaging with Scrum communities, attending training, obtaining certifications, and seeking feedback.
* Coaches the Scrum Team on Scrum practices, principles, and values, fostering self\-organization and continuous improvement.
* Facilitates collaboration and communication within the team and with stakeholders, promoting transparency and a culture of openness and trust.
* Encourages cross\-functional collaboration between Development Teams and other groups.
* Supports the Product Owner in managing the Product Backlog, refining User Stories, and prioritizing work to maximize value.
* Supports up to one Squad by facilitating group activities or workshops in complex and ambiguous situations with competing stakeholder needs.
* Designs structured sequences of meetings, events, or workshops to solve complex problems.
* Understands required outcomes and guides the team to deliver them.
* Facilitates all Scrum events—Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives—ensuring they are effective, focused, and time\-boxed.
* Removes impediments by identifying blockers, collaborating with stakeholders, and resolving issues proactively. Protects the team from external distractions during the Sprint.
* Helps improve team processes and performance in meetings, events, or workshops.
* Ensures Scrum artifacts such as the Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog, and Burndown Charts are transparent and up\-to\-date by working closely with the Product Owner and Development Team.
* Provides key metrics to senior stakeholders to maintain visibility into progress and priorities.



 The duties and responsibilities outlined above are to be regarded as broad areas of responsibility and do not necessarily detail all tasks which the post holder may be required to perform.
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

**Skills, Capabilities and Attributes**




 The ideal candidate will have the below skills, capabilities and attributes essential or preferred.
   

  




* Azure DevOps
* Jira
* Agile Methodologies \- Scrum/Kanban
* Awareness of Scaling
* Leading, educating, and coaching
* Efficiency improvement
* Documentation
* Lifecycle management
* Problem solving



  

  





**Measures of success**



* Improves team flow and delivery predictability through effective Scrum facilitation and coaching practices.
* Drives continuous improvement through retrospectives, actionable insights and measurable team outcomes.
* Removes impediments quickly while protecting team focus and enabling consistent Sprint delivery.
* Strengthens collaboration, transparency and trust across teams and stakeholders consistently.
* Ensures Scrum artefacts are accurate, visible and support informed decision\-making effectively.
* Supports Product Owner to refine backlog, improving clarity, prioritisation and delivery value.

description:
**Design the Future of Field Systems as a UI/UX Designer**
 Are you a rising design professional eager to work on a global team and solve complex, real\-world user challenges? As a UI/UX Designer at Trimble, you will collaborate with junior and senior designers across the globe to shape the digital experiences of web, mobile, and desktop software solutions that directly support users out in the construction field. If you have an eye for beautiful detail, an eagerness to learn, and a passion for modern design patterns, this is the perfect stage for your career growth.
   

  

**About Us**
 Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose\-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
   

  

**Our UX Culture:** 
 We offer a highly supportive, collaborative, and fun UX ecosystem. By joining us, you gain direct access to a growing global UI/UX infrastructure, including centralized style guides, robust design systems, and an extensive pattern library—all under the direct mentorship of a Lead UI/UX Designer.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Great**
 This role is a phenomenal launchpad for a junior designer looking to master the complexities of scaling the UX process across diverse product managers, developers, and global stakeholders. Based in our Chennai office, you will handle well\-defined, high\-impact design challenges. You will get immediate, hands\-on exposure to cutting\-edge design frontiers, such as crafting conversational AI assistants within spatial map environments, mapping seamless cloud connectivity for rugged field hardware, and turning complex data collection into intuitive mobile modules.
   

  

 Key Exciting Responsibilities
   

  

* Core Product Redesign \& AI Integration: Assist Senior UX Designers with core application overhauls and modules, focusing directly on the development of an intelligent AI assistant integrated within our geospatial map viewers.
* Feature Migration \& Scaling: Help detail the migration of critical field data collection capabilities into our core platform ecosystem and its corresponding vertical market editions.
* Cloud Connectivity Design: Support peer designers in detailing how field hardware connects dynamically to cloud applications, incorporating contextual cloud\-tips to enhance user onboarding across verticals.
* Research \& Customer Validation: Support user research and synthesis during field site visits for high\-priority initiatives, while leading customer validation efforts for interactive prototypes and new feature designs.
* Cross\-Functional Agile Alignment: Work closely with cross\-functional global engineering and PM teams on well\-defined design tasks, leveraging our central style guide to maintain impeccable visual consistency.


**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Professional Experience: 2–5 years of professional experience operating as a junior designer, backed by a compelling portfolio demonstrating clean, intuitive interaction layouts.
* Education: Undergraduate degree in User Experience Design, Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), Interaction Design, or a closely related design discipline.
* Industry Tools: High fluency with standard professional design software, specifically Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite.
* Agile Frameworks: Practical experience or structural familiarity working with UX processes inside an Agile product development environment.
* Growth Mindset: An eager, proactive "learn\-by\-doing" attitude, an appreciation for beautiful detail, a strong team spirit, and a willingness to accept creative direction.


**Bonus Points For**
* AI Prototyping: Direct project experience or a demonstrable interest in designing conversational AI tools and leveraging AI\-assisted prototyping workflows.
* Emerging Trends: Familiarity with emerging design technologies, modern mobile micro\-interactions, or spatial UI concepts.
* Originality: A proven readiness to actively pitch your own unique, original creative ideas while collaborating inside a structured enterprise framework.


**Logistics**
* Location: Chennai, India
* Level: P2
* Job Type: Full\-Time


 Why You'll Love Working With Us
   

  

 At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real\-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
   

  

* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose\-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* Collaborate with like\-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self\-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.


****How to Apply:****
 Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.
   

  

**Join a Values\-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**
 At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

title: Product Designer
description:
**About WeRize**




 Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle\-class customers who live in 5000\+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).
 



  





 This customer segments not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket\-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health and life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans,savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit.
 



  





 While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need proper guidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000\+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions. Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on\-the\-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when compared to upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t work for this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on\-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000\+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet\-on\-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.
 



  





 To know more about the company, please visit: https://www
 **.werize.com/**

 We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in Laboratory Digitalisation to lead regulatory strategy and IT\-enabled transformation initiatives in regulated GxP environments.  As a Manager at Regulatory Compliance, you will lead Digital Laboratory initiatives in regulated GxP environments, leveraging your deep expertise in Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), Electronic Laboratory Notebooks (ELN), Laboratory Execution Systems (LES), and strong consulting capabilities.
   

  

 Your primary responsibility will be to partner with clients to understand their laboratory business needs and translate strategic objectives into integrated, compliant, and practical digital lab solutions. * Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements for LIMS implementations/enhancements (LabWare, Benchling, STARLIMS), translating laboratory processes into functional specifications and user stories.

* Drive requirements gathering, system configuration, data migration, and integrations across lab systems, instruments, and enterprise platforms
* Ensure data integrity, traceability, and compliance with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, and internal SOPs
* Guide clients through CSV / CSA / risk‑based validation activities for digital lab systems
* Support audits, inspections, and regulatory assessments related to laboratory systems
* Identify opportunities for process harmonization, standardization, and digital enablement across laboratories


**People Responsibilities**
* Lead, coach, and mentor Digital Lab consultants, validation analysts, and technical team members
* Manage work allocation across LIMS, ELN, and LES engagements, ensuring quality delivery and adherence to timelines
* Conduct performance reviews, feedback, and development planning
* Build and strengthen Digital Lab and laboratory systems capabilities within the team
* Support hiring, onboarding, training, and knowledge‑transfer initiatives
* Foster a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement


**Decision\-Making Responsibilities:**
* Make informed decisions on delivery approach, validation strategy, and risk mitigation for digital lab programs
* Assess system, data, and compliance risks and proactively escalate issues to clients and EY leadership
* Support leadership in workforce planning, solution design, and practice development for Digital Lab offerings
* Guide decisions on vendor coordination, system design tradeoffs, and implementation timelines
* Apply structured and analytical thinking to improve delivery efficiency and client outcomes.


**Other Responsibilities**
* Contribute to business development, proposals, and client presentations related to Digital Lab initiatives
* Support inspection readiness, mock audits, and CAPA activities
* Stay current with regulatory expectations, industry trends, and emerging digital lab technologies
* Promote adoption of automation, analytics, and innovation within laboratory operations
* Collaborate with Quality, IT, Regulatory, and Manufacturing teams to deliver integrated solutions
* Uphold EY’s standards for ethics, quality, and compliance.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong understanding of regulated laboratory environments and quality‑driven operations
* Ability to identify process gaps, operational risks, and improvement opportunities
* Structured and analytical approach to problem‑solving and decision‑making
* Strong stakeholder and client‑management skills
* Ability to work effectively in global, cross‑functional teams
* Leadership mindset with the ability to guide teams and influence outcomes
* Consulting orientation balancing compliance, pragmatism, and delivery excellence
* High attention to detail with awareness of the broader business and compliance context
* Openness to digital transformation and innovation.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 8–12 years of experience in Digital Lab, LIMS, ELN, LES, or regulated laboratory systems
* Proven experience leading or supporting digital lab implementations, upgrades, or validation initiatives
* Experience working in regulated GxP environments, supporting audits and inspections
* Demonstrated experience managing teams, vendors, or complex stakeholders
* Strong documentation discipline and familiarity with controlled quality systems
* Ability to operate at a managerial level, balancing delivery and people leadership


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Certifications such as Labware Configuration, Sample Manager developer, Computer System Validation (CSV/CSA), or Project Management Professional (PMP).
* Experience with global or multi\-site digital laboratory implementations, upgrades, and inspection\-readiness activities.
* Familiarity with emerging technologies in laboratory operations, including automation, analytics, and AI/ML\-enabled solutions.
* Knowledge of data integrity principles, electronic records and signatures, and structured laboratory data management.
* Experience with industry\-leading digital lab platforms such as LabWare, SampleManager, STARLIMS, Benchling, or equivalent systems.


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1400 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

title: Lead Technical SEO Writer (No AI Writing, Human Content Only)
description:
**This is not a typical content role.** 




 If your instinct is to:
 


* Use ChatGPT to write content
* Optimize for speed over quality
* Follow templates without thinking



 This role is not for you.
 



  





**About Perfect Clicks LLC \- Based In New Jersey, USA** 




  





 Perfect Clicks is a performance\-driven SEO and digital marketing company focused on one core mission: creating irreplaceable, human\-written content that dominates Google rankings and becomes a source for AI systems. We don’t chase trends or shortcuts. We build long\-term digital assets through deep research, structured thinking, and high\-quality execution. Our work spans SEO, content strategy, branding, and full\-funnel marketing, all tied to measurable results including rankings, traffic, and revenue growth. With over a decade of experience, hundreds of brands served, and thousands of top\-ranking keywords, we operate as strategic partners—not vendors—helping businesses scale through content that compounds over time and cannot be replicated by AI. 
 



  





 We work with high\-traffic financial platforms, e\-commerce brands, media companies, startups, agencies, and enterprise clients. Since SEO content is the foundation of our business's marketing deliverables, you'll be responsible for writing high quality blog posts, articles, and case studies for a wide range of niches, including wealth management, hospitality, music therapy, pain management, finance, construction, food and restaurants, and more.
 



  





 We do not:
 


* Produce generic SEO content
* Use AI to write blogs
* Optimize for volume



  





 We do:
 


* Create specific, technical, value\-driven content
* Build real expertise through human\-created work
* Develop team members into strategic partners — not just writers



  





**The Role: Lead Technical SEO Writer** 




  





 As a technical writer with a focus in SEO marketing, you will start by writing — but this is not a traditional writing role.
 



 Writing is how you:
 


* Learn industries deeply
* Understand client businesses
* Develop strategic thinking



  





 This role is designed as a structured path from execution to strategy, where content writing is the foundation, not the end goal. You will begin by writing and contributing directly to client work, learning how to research, think, and produce high\-quality content that drives real SEO performance. As you develop, you will move from task\-based execution to owning outcomes—understanding client goals, analyzing data, and contributing to strategy. Over time, high performers transition into leadership roles, managing projects, guiding team members, and participating in client decision\-making. With a clear progression from training to independent contribution to strategic direction, this role is built to develop long\-term thinkers who can grow into executive\-level responsibilities within 6 months to 3 years based on performance and ownership.
 



  





**LOCATION:** 
 Virtual
 



**HOURS:** 
 8:30 AM EST to 5 PM EST (6 PM to 2:30 AM)
 



**SALARY:** 
 6 to 10 LPA
 



  





**Career Growth Path (Year 1\):** 




**Bootcamp Phase (0\-1 month)** 




 Intensive training focused on writing, research, and core frameworks. You will learn how to produce high\-quality, manual content, understand industries deeply, and build the foundation for strategic thinking. This phase is about learning how to think, not just execute.
 



**Core Team (1\-6 months)** 




 Transition into a full contributor role, owning content production and taking responsibility for quality, timelines, and communication. You will begin making independent decisions, improving efficiency, and developing a deeper understanding of client goals and SEO performance.
 



**Lead Team (6\-12\+ months)** 




 Move into strategy and leadership, managing projects, guiding team members, and contributing to client direction. You will take ownership of outcomes, including content performance, growth, and long\-term strategy, while mentoring others and helping scale operations.
 



  





 The goal is to become someone clients trust to make decisions and become a leader on our team, not just write blogs.
 



  





**Core Beliefs on AI Content vs. Human Content** 




  





 No generative AI tools for writing content.
 


* No ChatGPT
* No Gemini or Claude
* No AI\-generated drafts



  





*If AI can write your content, you are not adding value.* 




  





 AI\-generated content leads to generic output, weak differentiation, and poor long\-term performance. Our goal is to create content that AI cannot replicate, only reference.
 



  




* **AI\-generated writing is not allowed \-** 
 We maintain a zero\-tolerance policy for AI\-written content. It goes against our standards, our values, and the level of quality we expect.
* **AI content does not create value \-** 
 AI\-generated content is easy to produce, but also easy to replace. It lacks originality, depth, and true expertise—making it ineffective for long\-term SEO performance and client growth.
* **Human content is what AI depends on \-** 
 AI systems do not create knowledge—they aggregate it. The only content that holds value is original, human\-created insight that AI can reference and learn from.
* **We aim to be the source, not the output \-** 
 Our goal is to create content that ranks on Google and is used in AI Overviews, ChatGPT responses, and other AI systems—not content that competes with them.
* **AI usage reduces learning and expertise \-** 
 Relying on AI shortcuts limits your ability to think, analyze, and develop real skill. Manual work builds knowledge. AI dependence prevents it.



  





**What You’ll Actually Do** 



* Write 1–2 high\-quality blog posts daily using Perfect Clicks internal frameworks
* Translate complex information into clear, structured, user\-focused content
* Conduct SEO keyword research and analysis for client sites
* Continuously refine content based on feedback and performance
* Communicate proactively with a remote team working US hours
* Contribute to long\-term content strategy as you grow



  





**Brands, Topics, \& Industries** 




 You will work across a wide range of brands and industries, including:
 


* Forex broker platforms, proprietary trading firms, and wealth management companies
* Financial markets: bonds, commodities, cryptocurrencies, stock CFDs, ETFs, indices, options
* Trading strategies, platform features, and investment analysis
* B2B SaaS platforms, software tools, and product workflows
* Medical and healthcare services and procedures
* Construction and local service industries (projects, pricing, materials)
* E\-commerce and consumer products (comparisons, positioning, conversion content)



  





**Benefits** 



* Paid sick time
* Pain vacation time
* Paid holidays
* Flexible unpaid time off



  





  





**We are not looking for:** 




  




* Generic SEO writers
* People who want easy, repetitive work
* Candidates who rely on AI tools



  





  





**We are looking for:** 




  





**Quality\-First Thinkers \-** 
 You get frustrated by generic content, care about doing things properly, and notice when something is off.
 



**Methodical Learners** 
 \- You ask questions before starting, want to understand why, and take time to do things right.
 



**High Ownership Individuals** 
 \- You communicate proactively, do not cut corners, and take responsibility for outcomes.
 



**Long\-Term Builders** 
 \- You want to develop real skills, grow into strategy, and are willing to do hard things now for long\-term growth.
 



  





  





**Who Should Not Apply** 



* You prefer using AI tools for writing
* You prioritize speed over quality
* You struggle with detailed feedback
* You avoid asking questions
* You want quick, low\-effort work



  





**Why This Role Is Different** 




 Most companies want more content, faster, and use AI to scale output. We are doing the opposite.
 



 We believe the future belongs to people who think first, not people who prompt first.
 



  





**Growth and Opportunity** 



* Direct mentorship and structured feedback

* Opportunity to work closely with leadership

title: Reporter
description:
**Company Description** 




 Mercom India Private Limited is a clean energy communications and research firm in India. We are a subsidiary of US\-based Mercom Capital Group, a leading clean energy communication and consulting firm recognized worldwide for its expertise in renewable energy.
 



  





 MercomIndia.com is a news portal covering clean energy news and happenings in India.
 



  





 Located in Bangalore, Mercom India has been providing communications services nationwide for clean energy organizations since early 2009\.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 Mercom India is a well\-known, respected research and communications firm focused on delivering critical information on renewable energy. With growing environmental issues and air pollution concerns, India is shifting from dirty fossil fuels to clean energy technologies. We are looking for a reporter who wants to be part of a dynamic online news portal (mercomindia.com) focused on renewable and clean technologies in India, who is excited to be part of the solution and change India's energy and environmental future. The ideal candidate will be expected to write, edit and proofread articles, blog posts, and press releases on renewable energy topics and market trends. We are looking to create the best resource for renewable energy news in India.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will have experience covering energy or business stories in India and will be able to analyze data, news and trends, and develop original content. The candidate will report on the news on tight deadlines. The job will involve working with colleagues across India and abroad to ensure comprehensive market coverage.
 



  





 The candidate will be responsible for breaking news, covering important stories about companies of all sizes, government policies, and technologies, and contributing multiple stories each week, all written in the right tone. The ideal candidate will have 1\-2 years of news writing experience and be excited to be part of the dynamic sector of India’s renewable energy growth story.
 



         ·        Write and publish multiple articles on a daily basis, ranging from quick to covering the latest on a breaking news event with photos
 



         ·        Write daily and long\-term stories, including reported pieces and detailed analysis for the news website and our weekly newsletter/reports
 



         ·        Develop fresh angles and offer new insights for readers. Report news on tight deadlines, which includes making calls, asking tough questions, and aggressively pursuing a story when needed
 



         ·        Call on various government agencies to get the appropriate information and news
 



         ·        Stay on top of and follow up on current events coming out of the clean energy sector
 



         ·        Must be able to develop sources/relationships to call on for quotes and information
 



         ·        This position is based in Bangalore
 







**Desired profile of the candidate:** 




  





      ·        Must have superior writing and editing skills coupled with the demonstrated ability to present information concisely and clearly at an appropriate level of sophistication
 



         ·        Must have strong interview skills, with an ability to extract relevant information about technical and complex topics and turn it into easy\-to\-understand written content
 



         ·        Must be able to analyze data, news and trends, and write concise articles that are compelling and easy to understand
 



         ·        Must be able to monitor and identify news on a daily basis and break news as often as possible
 



         ·        Must be internet savvy and have the ability to carry out qualitative online research
 



         ·        Experience in writing financial and technical articles, in American\-style English writing a plus
 



         ·        Journalistic and reporting background necessary
 



         ·        Knowledge and familiarity with online publishing tools, WordPress, and HTML a plus
 



         ·        The candidate should have an eagerness to learn and adapt to new situations and different environments
 



         ·        Must be able to travel occasionally anywhere in India
 



         ·        Should be a voracious reader of business news and current events
 



         ·        Must be strong in ethical values and social conduct
 



         ·        Must be an excellent fact checker and should have the ability to verify all the news items from various sources
 



         ·        Must be proactive and able to work independently
 



         ·        Must be organized, able to meet deadlines and juggle various tasks while at the same time maintaining a high level of attention to detail and sustaining overall quality
 



         ·        Must be creative, flexible and willing to do what it takes to deliver a finished product
 



 Salary is commensurate with experience. Please submit a resume with at least three to five stories
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong skills in Reporting and News Writing
* Proficiency in Writing and Communication, with excellent command of the English language
* Experience in creating and working with Multimedia content
* Ability to analyze and report on complex topics with accuracy and clarity
* Strong research skills and attention to detail
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced newsroom environment
* Degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field is preferred
* Familiarity with clean energy markets or prior experience in similar industries is a plus

title: Risk Consulting - Digital Risk -Staff - Application Security
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Risk Consulting – Digital Risk – Staff:**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are expanding our Digital Risk team and are looking for Staff with strong hands\-on expertise across at least two of the following domains:
   

  

* IT Risk
* Cloud Risk
* Technology Controls Assurance
* Third Party Digital Risk
* Cyber and Operational Resilience


 As Staff, you’ll contribute technically to client engagements and internal projects.
   

  

 You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues.
   

  

 You will anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team. In line with EY commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Client Delivery**
* Participate in application security engagements, including Threat Modelling and SDL reviews
* Perform architecture and design security assessments to identify potential risks and control gaps
* Evaluate secure SDLC controls, including design reviews, code security practices, and release governance
* Work closely with asset owners, developers, and stakeholders to explain findings and remediation actions
* Document security findings and assist in preparing client reports and presentations
* Track remediation efforts and follow up with stakeholders to ensure closure
* Continuously strive to exceed client and team expectations while handling increasingly complex assignments
* Manage day\-to\-day client relationships, leading client meetings, working sessions, and status reporting.


**People Responsibilities**
* Maintain an ongoing learning plan to enhance application security and threat modelling skills
* Adherent to organizational policies and security standards
* Participate in training programs related to secure coding, cloud security, and AppSec tools
* Exhibit initiative, teamwork, and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team
* Support junior team members when required


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Experience in:
+ Threat Modelling methodologies (STRIDE, PASTA, etc)
+ Secure SDLC practices and security controls
+ OWASP Top 10 and common application vulnerabilities
+ Using SAST/DAST and security testing tools
+ Reviewing authentication, authorization, encryption, and API security controls

* Strong understanding of:
+ Application architecture (web, APIs, Azure, Power automate)
+ Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelor’s degree in B.E./B.Tech (Computer Science, IT, Electronics) or M.Sc./MCA
* At least 1–2 years of experience in Application Security / Secure SDLC / Threat Modelling


**Additionally, Good To Have**
* Ability to work in fast\-paced client environments with multiple priorities
* Analytical mindset with attention to detail in identifying security gaps
* Strong communication skills with ability to interact with asset owners and technical stakeholders.
* Proven experience in direct client facing roles, partnering with cross functional teams to deliver assessment and remediation activities.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Exposure to cyber risk tooling and automation.
* Prior Big 4 or consulting leadership experience.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
