title: SDE I (Frontend)
description:
**About Navi** 




 At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology\-first products built at scale.
 



 Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.
 



 Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low\-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India’s fastest\-growing UPI platforms.
 



**What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey.** 




  





**Why Explore a Career at Navi?** 




**Where Ownership Creates Real Impact** 




 At Navi, ownership starts early. People here are trusted to solve problems, make decisions and drive outcomes that directly shape the products and experiences used by millions of customers every day.
 



**Where Careers Accelerate** 




 Growth at Navi is driven by impact, not tenure. We strongly believe in promoting from within and creating opportunities for people to take on larger responsibilities as they grow. If you consistently raise the bar, you’ll find the space to grow quickly here.
 



**Where Great Talent Builds Together** 




 We take pride in building high talent\-density teams where ambitious people learn from one another every day. Working on high\-scale business and technology problems creates steep learning curves, fast execution cycles and opportunities to make visible impact throughout your journey.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a “UI Engineer \- 1” who is curious, strong in frontend fundamentals, and eager to build reliable user\-facing products. This role is suited for early\-career frontend engineers who enjoy solving problems, writing clean code, and learning through collaboration. At Navi, we value clarity of thought, problem\-solving approach, frontend fundamentals, and growth mindset.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* Analyze product and technical problems and design efficient solutions with a focus on performance and customer experience.
* Build user\-facing web interfaces using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and preferably React or similar framework.
* Translate product requirements into clean, functional, and maintainable UI.
* Debug frontend issues and reason through code behavior step by step.
* Apply basic security best practices across all features you build.
* Write unit tests (and higher\-level tests with senior guidance) covering happy paths, edge cases, and robust error handling.
* Write readable and organized code that other engineers can understand and maintain.
* Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product teams to ship reliable frontend experiences.



  





**What Makes You a Great Fit** 



* 0\-2 years of frontend engineering experience (including internships, academic, or personal projects).
* Good understanding of JavaScript fundamentals: closures, scope, event loop, async behavior, prototypes, and "this".
* Working knowledge of React or similar frontend frameworks.
* Basic understanding of UI architecture: components, state, props, rendering, and data flow.
* Awareness of web performance, and test driven development.
* Ability to communicate thought processes clearly while solving problems.
* Experience with browser devtools and basic debugging.



  





**The Navi OS** 




 The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values.
 


* **Start with the Customer**
* Master the Details
* Act with Urgency
* Own the Outcome
* Build for a Decade \- Not a Day
* Win as One



 We hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation.
 



 To read more about the Navi OS, visit
 
 navi.com/our\-values
 




  





**Life at Navi** 




 Life at Navi is fast\-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.
 



 We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well\-being.
 



 Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable.
 



 If you’d like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page:
 
 navi.com/careers/life\-at\-navi
 




  





 If solving meaningful problems, building at scale and growing alongside ambitious teams excites you,
 



**Navi could be the place for you.**

description:
**Business Unit:** 
 Creative Cloud

**Our company** 
 Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to create appealing and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Digital Video Audio (DVA) group’s portfolio consists of world class products across desktop, mobile and cloud catering to professional customers. Some of the products and services that the team develops includes Adobe Premiere Rush, Adobe Premiere Pro etc. As part of the team you will be responsible for one or more of the following:
   

  

* Developing features for Premiere Pro.
* Developing core color algorithm supporting Adobe Premiere Pro.
* Developing imaging or video processing algorithms that can solve some of the hard problems faced by our customers.


**What You’ll Do**
* As an Individual contributor, develop new framework/features, maintain product features with responsibility for the full product development cycle from early specs, prototypes to implementation to release and maintenance.
* Conceptualization of product design, estimation, risk analysis, development and debugging.

 We are seeking a motivated and skilled Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) Developer to join our Business Group. In this role, you will assist in the design, development, and maintenance of integration solutions that connect our Oracle Cloud Fusion ecosystem with internal and external systems. You will play a key role in supporting our manufacturing and fulfillment processes by applying your technical knowledge of OIC, VBCS, and Oracle SCM. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem\-solver who enjoys working in a collaborative team and is eager to develop robust, efficient integration solutions.

* Core OIC Proficiency: Hands\-on experience with REST integrations, fault handlers, and basic orchestration patterns.
* Technical Skillset: Proficiency in PL/SQL, XML/JSON parsing, and XPath expressions.
* Experience building applications using VBCS and an interest in Oracle Redwood UI design principles.
* Familiarity with Oracle Cloud Fusion SaaS tables, UI navigation, and standard integration points.
* Functional understanding of Oracle SCM, particularly within Manufacturing and Fulfillment modules, and interest in Oracle WMS Cloud.
* Ability to troubleshoot integration issues and contribute to the development of reusable components.
* Effective analytical skills with the ability to communicate technical tasks clearly to team members.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience working in a manufacturing or supply chain environment.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and project management tools.

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond.  We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Software Engineer, Firmware
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in embedded systems or firmware development.
* Experience in embedded software or firmware development in C or C\+\+.
* Experience in bringing up bare\-metal environments on SoCs.
* Experience in performing firmware debugging on silicon and using debugging tools (e.g., TRACE32 or OpenOCD).


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in using emulation platforms for firmware enablement, validation, and debug.
* Experience with ARM and RISC\-V architectures.
* Experience in industry standard software development practices and agile methodologies.
* Understanding of SoC architecture and interfaces (e.g., Advanced Extensible Interface (AXI), Double Data Rate (DDR), Peripheral Component Interconnect Express (PCIe), etc.).


**About The Job**
 Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
   

  

 With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.
   

  

 The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
   

  

 We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop embedded firmware, bare metal tests and low\-level debug tools for pre and post\-silicon validation of SoCs. Exercise these capabilities on emulation, simulation and silicon platforms.
* Co\-work with architecture, design and verification teams and enable hardware\-software co\-design.
* Engage with silicon design teams at a very early stage and drive integration validation and firmware features enablement as the silicon development progresses.
* Work closely with post\-silicon and platform hardware teams to ensure silicon enablement and support silicon debugs.

 Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. We ensure critical security patches and new features are delivered to customers at the Operating System (OS) level.

* Prepare interview schedules and recruitment status reports.

**What You Will Learn**

During this internship, you will gain practical experience in:

**Recruitment**

* End\-to\-end recruitment process.
* Resume screening techniques.
* Candidate sourcing strategies.
* Interview coordination.
* Candidate experience management.
* Recruitment reporting and analytics.

**HR Operations**

* Employee onboarding process.
* HR documentation and compliance.

* Exit management and clearance process.

**Professional Skills**

* Business communication.
* Email etiquette.
* Interview coordination.
* Stakeholder management.
* Time management.
* Workplace professionalism.
* Problem\-solving and ownership.

**Skills Required**

* Good communication skills in English.
* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Basic knowledge of Human Resources.
* Willingness to learn.
* Good organizational skills.
* Attention to detail.
* Ability to multitask.
* Positive attitude and professionalism.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Human Resource Management, Business Administration (BBA/MBA), Psychology, Commerce, Management, or a related field.**

* Maintain accurate recruitment and HR records.

* Passionate about building a career in Human Resources.
* Well\-organized and detail\-oriented.
* Confident in communicating with candidates and employees.
* Able to manage multiple tasks in a **fast\-paced environment**.
* Professional, proactive, and willing to take ownership.

**Career Growth**

This internship provides real\-world exposure to Recruitment and HR Operations within an advertising agency. Based on your performance, ownership, learning ability, and contribution to the team, you may be offered a full\-time opportunity at Dangura Digital.

**At Dangura Digital, we believe HR is more than hiring—it's about building strong teams, maintaining efficient operations, and creating a positive employee experience. If you're eager to learn and grow, we'd love to have you on board.**

description:
**Junior Electronics Engineer — Job Description**

**Company Overview**

Xalten Systems is a forward\-thinking technology company building cutting\-edge solutions for various industries and the defence sector, with a focus on precision automation and sensor systems. As a startup, we operate from a first\-principles approach — tackling complex problems head\-on and building efficient, elegant solutions from the ground up.

**Role**

We are seeking a highly motivated Junior Electronics Engineer to join our dynamic, fast\-paced team. This is an excellent opportunity for a passionate fresher to kick\-start their career and learn how to take electronic designs from concept to production. Under the guidance of senior engineers, you will assist with schematic design, component sourcing, prototyping, assembly, testing, and validation.

The ideal Junior Electronics Engineer is an eager, curious learner with a disciplined, systematic approach to documentation and testing — someone who collaborates well across teams, asks questions freely, and takes full ownership of their learning curve to deliver quality results on time.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Design \& Sourcing:**  Assist in the design, development, simulation, and prototyping of reliable electronic circuits and test boards; research and source components, modules, and subsystems, coordinating with vendors and suppliers.
* **Documentation \& Integration:**  Maintain technical documentation (BOMs, schematics, test reports, usage guides), and support implementation and testing of electronic designs for robotic, embedded, and sensor systems.
* **Collaboration \& Testing:**  Work with firmware, software, and mechanical teams on project requirements and design reviews; validate product functionality, troubleshoot hardware bugs, and perform bench testing.
* **Growth \& Delivery:**  Proactively learn industry trends and design tools, prioritize tasks, and deliver quality work on time.

**Qualifications**

* **Education:**  Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical \& Electronics Engineering, or a closely related field.
* **Experience:**  Freshers with a strong passion for electronics, academic projects, or internship experience in hardware design are highly encouraged to apply.

**Core Knowledge \& Skills**

* Strong academic foundation in analog circuit design, digital electronics, and network analysis.
* Basic understanding of mixed\-signal circuit design and integrating analog/digital components.
* Familiarity with schematic capture and PCB layout tools (e.g., KiCad, Altium, Eagle, or Orcad) learned through academic or personal projects.
* Fundamental understanding of microcontrollers (e.g., Arduino, STM32, ESP32\), peripherals, and standard protocols (I2C, SPI, UART).
* Basic awareness of power supplies, voltage regulators, and thermal management in electronic circuits.

**Additional Skills \& Tools**

* **Test \& Measurement:**  Comfortable or eager to learn lab equipment — DSOs, logic analyzers, signal generators, multimeters, electronic loads, and variable power supplies — plus basic soldering and hardware troubleshooting.
* **Good to Have:**  C/C\+\+ for embedded systems, VHDL/Verilog or DSP basics, Git/version control, and participation in robotics or electronics competitions are all a plus.
* **Essential Traits:**  Eagerness to learn best practices, strong attention to detail, proactive initiative, coachability, and good written/verbal communication for documentation and teamwork.

**How to Apply**

Send your resume and a cover letter to careers@xaltensystems.com with "Junior Electronics Engineer" in the subject line. Please also mention your area of interest — ‘Hardware’, ‘Software’, or ‘Embedded’— in your application.

title: Portfolio Delivery Director
description:
Chennai, Tamil Nadu
  
Job Summary
  
  

Role Purpose
  
  

The Delivery Head – India Business will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end delivery across a portfolio of India\-based customer accounts for an IT Services / IT Outsourcing organization. The role will own delivery excellence, revenue achievement, customer satisfaction, account growth support, team scalability, and operational governance.
  
  

The ideal candidate would be a strong portfolio delivery leader currently working with a Tier\-2 IT Services company in India, managing multiple customer accounts, delivery teams, and business commitments.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Delivery \& Program Management
  
  

Lead delivery across multiple programs, projects, and managed services engagements for India\-based customers.
  
Ensure agreed deliverables are met in terms of time, cost, quality, scope, and contractual commitments.
  
Establish strong governance across accounts, including delivery reviews, risk tracking, issue resolution, and escalation management.
  
Drive predictability in delivery through proactive planning, resource management, quality control, and stakeholder communication.
  
Ensure adherence to SLAs, KPIs, delivery milestones, and customer expectations.
  
  

Business \& Revenue Management
  
  

Own revenue delivery targets for the assigned India customer portfolio.
  
Support achievement of business results through delivery excellence, customer retention, and account expansion.
  
Assist Sales and Account teams in business development, account mining, bid defense, proposal reviews, and contract reviews.
  
Identify growth opportunities within existing accounts and help initiate potential new customer projects.
  
Ensure delivery operations support revenue realization, margin goals, and profitable growth.
  
  

Customer Relationship \& Engagement
  
  

Build and maintain strong relationships with senior customer stakeholders across assigned accounts.
  
Act as the delivery owner and escalation point for customer delivery matters.
  
Ensure high customer satisfaction, customer retention, and referencability.
  
Conduct regular governance meetings, account reviews, and delivery performance discussions.
  
Partner with Account and Sales teams to strengthen customer relationships and support business growth.
  
  

People Leadership \& Capability Building
  
  

Work closely with HR, recruitment, and resource management teams to fulfill project and account staffing needs.
  
Build and scale delivery teams in line with business growth.
  
Guide, mentor, and develop project managers, delivery managers, architects, technical leads, and engineering teams.
  
Drive performance management, capability development, employee engagement, and retention.
  
Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
  
  

Process Excellence \& Compliance
  
  

Anchor process improvement, delivery compliance, and organizational initiatives across the portfolio.
  
Ensure adherence to internal delivery frameworks, quality standards, security requirements, and customer\-specific processes.
  
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, quality, delivery efficiency, and customer experience.
  
Monitor delivery health through metrics, dashboards, audits, and governance mechanisms.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

Scope of Responsibility
  
  

Meeting revenue targets for the assigned India business portfolio.
  
Delivering projects and services as per contractual commitments.
  
Maintaining strong customer relationships across India\-based accounts.
  
Ensuring customer satisfaction and customer referencability.
  
Supporting business expansion through mining of existing accounts.
  
Partnering with Sales and Account teams for customer growth.
  
Building and expanding delivery teams as business scales.
  
Managing delivery performance, risks, escalations, and governance.
  
  

Required Qualifications \& Experience
  
  

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  
18\+ years of experience in IT Services, IT Consulting, or IT Outsourcing.
  
Strong experience in delivery management, program management, and portfolio management.
  
Experience managing multiple India\-based customer accounts with revenue, delivery, and customer satisfaction accountability.
  
Proven ability to manage large delivery teams across application development, maintenance, digital, cloud, data, or managed services engagements.
  
Experience in supporting proposals, bid defense, solution reviews, contract reviews, and account growth initiatives.
  
Strong understanding of delivery governance, project financials, resource management, quality processes, and risk management.
  
  

Preferred Candidate Profile
  
  

Currently working in India with a Tier\-2 Indian IT Services / IT Outsourcing company.
  
Currently managing a portfolio of customer accounts with end\-to\-end delivery responsibility.
  
Could be operating as a Portfolio Manager, Delivery Director, Program Director, Senior Delivery Manager, or Account Delivery Leader.
  
Should have started the career from a technical background and grown into delivery leadership.
  
Strong technology acumen with the ability to engage with technical teams, architects, business stakeholders, and customer leadership.
  
Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  
Demonstrated ability to manage delivery outcomes, customer satisfaction, team performance, and business growth together.
  
  

Key Competencies
  
  

Portfolio Delivery Management
  
Customer Relationship Management
  
Revenue and Margin Orientation
  
Program and Project Governance
  
Account Mining and Growth Support
  
Team Building and People Leadership
  
Technology Acumen
  
Risk and Escalation Management
  
Process Compliance and Continuous Improvement
  
Strong Executive Communication
  
  

Key Success Metrics
  
  

Revenue Achievement
  
Gross Margin / Profitability
  
Customer Satisfaction
  
Customer Referencability
  
SLA and KPI Compliance
  
On\-time and On\-budget Delivery
  
Account Growth Support
  
Resource Utilization
  
Delivery Quality
  
Employee Engagement and Retention
  
  

Compliance and Governance Adherence

Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

We are looking for a strategic and customer\-centric Pre\-Sales Bid Manager to manage the pursuits and solutioning efforts for customer RFXs. This role requires expertise in interpreting customer requirements, storyboarding solutions, and orchestrating cross\-functional solution teams. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building a broad understanding of all solutions offered by HCL Tech and can effectively articulate the business values of each, in ways that resonate with customers. As pre\-sales, you should also be able leverage and integrate various solution components from the Solution team and contribute towards building and articulate overall solution story to fulfil the customer requirements and needs. This role involves working on sales opportunities across ANZ and ASEAN territories; and involves driving deals spanning multiple technologies / service offerings, industry domains and verticals.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Assess key client objectives and problems and HCL’s ability to win along with high level value proposition.
  
Structure and produce compelling response proposals, commercial and technical documentation outlining the commercial and value benefits to the customer
  
Liaising with multiple internal stakeholders across Legal, HR, Finance, Solutions, Delivery Etc.
  
**Financial engineering of the RFP:** Understand what cost models and options suit/work for the opportunity.
  
Support sales teams across all stages of the opportunity life cycle
  
Proactive Opportunity building to propose potential business opportunities including Market and Industry research.
  
Administer and execute client visits including agenda planning, collateral presentations, and anchor meetings.
  
Pre and post visit analysis with customer feedback to understand opportunity areas and position relevant stakeholders.
  
Prepare questionnaire / templates to ensure information is gathered seamlessly and shared / articulated among the internal stakeholders.
  
To maintain repository of proposal documents \& previous bid responses; keep track of latest industry trends.
  
To coordinate with internal stakeholders
  
To create and maintain KM repository
  
Skill Requirements
  
Proven experience in IT Pre\-Sales, Pursuit Management and Solutioning.
  
Strong understanding of enterprise IT landscapes including cloud, infrastructure, applications, and managed services.
  
Experience and understanding of AI, GenAI and Agentic AI concepts, usage and implementation.
  
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  
Ability to lead cross\-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.
  
Strategic thinking with a proactive, customer\-first mindset.
  
Experience in account mining and opportunity development for EN business.
  
Other Requirements
  
Ability to work well under pressure within high performance driven environment
  
Should be able to explore any new technology as self\-starter and ability to explore new product / technology at short notice.
  
Very good communication and negotiation skills (both written and verbal).
  
Agility and quick learner
  
Good Analytical and problem\-solving skills
  
Self\-motivated with the ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and manage changing priorities
  
Ability to manage the bridge calls with customers on technical issues/pages
  
Willingness to work in 24/7 shift environment (Including nights, weekends and holidays)

title: Site Facilities, Environment, Health & Safety, and Security (FEHSS) Manager
description:
The Site FEHSS Manager is the single accountable site leader for Facilities, Environment, Health \& Safety, and Physical Security. The role protects Sensata's people, property, and planet by ensuring full regulatory compliance, operating a risk\-based management system aligned to global Sensata standards, and delivering reliable facility infrastructure that enables uninterrupted manufacturing operations.  

This is a hands\-on leadership role. The FEHSS Manager executes hazard identification and risk control, drives a injury prevention safety culture, maintains critical building systems, leads site physical security programs to protect people, property, and critical business assets, and delivers accurate safety, environmental and energy data for corporate reporting.
General Responsibilities  

* Manages the design, planning, construction, renovation of buildings and infrastructure
* Plans, budgets, and schedules facility modifications, including estimates on equipment, labor, materials and other related costs
* Develop and deploy organizational policies relevant to the facilities department
* Manages the coordination of building space allocation and layout, communication services and facilities expansion
* Selects, develops, and evaluates personnel to ensure the efficient operation of the function
* Develops plans and programs that meet present and anticipated space and facility requirements
* Manages the monitoring and inspecting of all buildings and equipment to ensure that utility systems are fully operational and that preventive maintenance schedules are being followed
* Prepares cost estimates for building renovations or space allocations

  

Experience / Qualifications  

* A university degree required (i.e. Bachelors degree) or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Ability to lead, coach, and develop team members
* Holds self and others accountable to achieving goals and standards
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment to handle multiple competing tasks and demands
* Strong communication skills; oral, written and presentation
* Strong organization, planning and time management skills to achieve results
* Strong personal and professional ethical values and integrity
* Proficient in Microsoft Office programs (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel)
* Strong interpersonal \& collaboration skills to work effectively with all levels of the organization including suppliers and/or external customers
**Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS)**
---------------------------------------

* Own site compliance with all applicable EHS laws, permits, and Sensata global EHS standards; maintain a live legal register with zero major regulatory findings.
* Execute the global incident management process: reporting, classification and escalation, Incident reporting, root\-cause investigations with effective corrective actions closed on time.
* Lead injury prevention: identify and control high\-energy hazards (machine safety, LOTO, electrical, chemical, working at height, powered industrial vehicles) through risk assessment and the hierarchy of controls.
* Drive leading\-indicator performance: hazard observations, near\-miss reporting, leadership safety walks, and EHS training completion.
* Operate the site management system to ISO 45001, and ISO 14001; lead internal audits, management reviews, and external certification readiness.
* Manage occupational health programs: industrial hygiene monitoring, ergonomics, occupational medical surveillance, and first\-aid/emergency medical response.
* Manage environmental compliance: air emissions, wastewater/effluent, hazardous and non\-hazardous waste, chemical management, and spill prevention and response.
* Deliver accurate, timely Scope 1 and Scope 2 energy and GHG activity data into corporate sustainability reporting systems (single source of truth discipline).
* Execute site\-level decarbonization, waste\-reduction, and water\-stewardship projects in support of corporate SBTi commitments and targets.

**Facilities \& Infrastructure**
--------------------------------

* Operate and maintain all building systems, HVAC, chillers, cooling towers, air compressors and compressed air distribution, electrical distribution, UPS/generators, fire protection, and water systems, to defined reliability and uptime targets.
* Run a structured preventive/predictive maintenance program; manage work\-order backlog and critical spares.
* Plan and execute facility capital projects: scoping, budgeting, contractor selection, construction safety oversight, and commissioning.
* Manage soft services (cleaning, cafeteria, grounds, potable water \& waste logistics) and facility vendor contracts to defined service levels and cost targets.
* Own site energy management: monitor consumption, deliver efficiency projects, and support ISO 50001\-aligned practices and renewable energy initiatives.
* Ensure building and fire code compliance, statutory inspections and certifications, and business continuity readiness for facility\-related disruption.
* Develop and manage operating (OPEX) budgets for FEHSS function
* Control costs while ensuring reliability, compliance, and safety standards
* Analyze performance metrics and drive cost optimization initiatives
* Manage vendor contracts and service agreements

**Physical Security**
---------------------

* Implement and maintain Sensata global physical security standards: access control, CCTV, perimeter protection, visitor and contractor management, and key/badge governance.
* Manage the site guard force (proprietary or contract) including post orders, training, and performance management.
* Conduct periodic site security risk assessments; maintain and test security incident response plans in coordination with Global Physical Security.
* Support compliance security requirements including C\-TPAT, TISAX, ITAR, AEO (or regional equivalent), customer security audits, and export\-control physical safeguards where applicable.
* Lead site investigations (theft, misconduct, workplace violence concerns) in partnership with HR, Legal, and Global Physical Security; maintain confidentiality and chain of custody.

**Emergency Preparedness \& Crisis Management**
-----------------------------------------------

* Own the integrated site emergency response plan covering fire, medical, chemical release, natural disaster, security threat, and utility failure scenarios.
* Train and drill the site Emergency Response Team; conduct at least \[insert frequency] full\-site drills annually with documented lessons learned.
* Serve as site crisis coordinator, activating regional and corporate escalation per the GSSO classification and escalation matrix.

**Leadership, Governance \& Reporting**
---------------------------------------

* Build and develop a capable site FEHSS team; set objectives, coach performance, and plan succession.
* Report site FEHSS performance through the GSSO governance rhythm using the standard KPI framework; ensure data integrity in all corporate systems.
* Influence site leadership and supervision to own safety outcomes; embed FEHSS requirements into daily management systems and Gemba routines.
* Partner across functions (Operations, HR, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain) and with peer FEHSS Managers to share and adopt best practices.

**Certifications \& Statutory Qualifications:**
-----------------------------------------------

* Nationally recognized safety qualification meeting the statutory Safety Officer requirement of the operating country.
* At least one internationally recognized professional credential — e.g., NEBOSH IGC/Diploma, CSP/ASP, CRSP, CMIOSH, or equivalent — or commitment to obtain within 18 months of appointment.
* Internal auditor training for ISO 45001 or ISO 14001 (or obtained within 12 months).

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Master's degree in engineering, EHS, or management.
* Certified Energy Manager (CEM), fire safety credential, or facilities management credential (IFMA FMP/CFM).
* Experience in automotive, electronics, or sensor manufacturing environments (IATF 16949 exposure).
* Experience with C\-TPAT, ITAR, TISAX or equivalent security programs and customer security audits.
* Multi\-site or regional FEHSS exposure; experience deploying corporate standards at site level.

**Smarter****Together**
=======================

* Collaborating at Sensata means working with some of the world’s most talented people in an **enriching environment**that is constantly pushing towards the next best thing
* Employees work across functions, countries and cultures gaining **new perspectives**through mutual respect and open communication
* As OneSensata, we are working together to make things work together

description:

 Senior Manager, RES, HT India **Job Code**

Country Head of Real Estate Services **LoB/Function \& Location:**

  

GCOO / Real Estate Services**Grade**
=========

  

 GCB 4 **Regulatory Designation** *(if applicable)*

 *N/A* **Role purpose** *(overall high level summary of the role)** The role reports to the Country Head of Real Estate Services to set strategy, budget objectives \& provide governance and oversight to this role in collaboration with the Country Head of Real Estate Services.
* The role is expected to provide leadership of HSBC’s Real Estate Services (as defined at regional level) delivery in Market entity to improve our employee \& workplace experience.
* The role will manage and deliver Real Estate Services for the Entity in the Market, including Workplace Experience Services (Facilities Management, Property and Asset Management, Workplace Management \& Transformation); Future of Work Transformation, ESG/Sustainable Operations.
* The role holder will support managing the expansion of Real Estate Services related utilities
* The role holder will be expected to demonstrate the ability to lead and transform the Real Estate Services function in a market to a value and outcome focused way of working.
* The role is required to work in conjunction with the regional RES team to align with regional RES strategy and to ensure SME delivery for the entity in the market.

 **Principal Accountabilities and Responsibilities** (*e.g., for Business, Customers and Stakeholders; internal control environment, etc.)***Business*** Ensure that real estate is a key business enabler, through the delivery of innovative and forward thinking initiatives relating to the portfolio which supports the business needs across Portfolio Optimisation, Workplace and Facilities Management Solutions, Retail Solutions, Enviornmental, Social \& Goverance (ESG), Critical Facilities, Future of Work Transformation and Risk Management.
* Have an active and ongoing learning focus on ESG/Sustainable Operations to ensure the increased understanding, knowledge and adoption of energy efficient, renewable energy, waste management and recycling, sustainable diets and resource consumption activities and certifications (LEED, WELL and WiredScore).
* Have a strong grasp of data compilation and data\-driven decision making to meet RES and Sustainable Operations targets.
* Aligned to regional RES leadership and strategy, guide the local businesses in the future of work strategy, in partnership with HR, which considers the future workplace, employee experience, technology needs and people impacts; providing a healthy, safe and sustainable solution to support the current and future needs of HSBC.
* Advise and assist business on the operations, marketing and review of owned assets with a view to ensure consistency of HSBC’s real estate strategy from a Landlord/Investor context.
* Operate and manage any owned assets P\&L
* Ensure the management of strategic business partners including the KPI reviews, maintaining compliance to any global/regional MSA or other local service agreement
* Implement the agreed strategy and provide a forward looking view of occupancy and associated expense to identify key business decision points and options, supported by insightful MI
* Lead workplace strategy and play a key role in shaping, enabling and embedding the Bank’s Future of Work program in the local market, moving towards a more hybrid and flexible model of working between office and home.
* Drive innovative ‘end to end’ customer focused solutions that optimise the banks’ portfolio across the RES function’s themes of data, innovation and technology.
* Embrace business partnering to ensure a close understanding of individual business requirements, ensuring alignment to overall Group Real Estate Services objectives
* Drive change \& people development to ensure the function innovates and evolves to match the changing dynamics of the industry and the expectations of a multigenerational customer and employee base
* Manage the strategic planning of the Entity in the Market property portfolio which includes any creation of a property investment company or Joint venture to manage or redevelop HSBC’s residential and commercial property
* Responsible for the Travel and Expense policies for Real Estate Services employees for the Entity in the Market
* Utilise and support centrally developed golden sources of tools and data to ensure opportunities for efficiencies and consistent reporting

 **Customers and Stakeholders*** Support engagement with regulators to understand current and future regulatory requirements related to all Real Estate Services capabilities
* Engage and develop strong relationships with stakeholders across the Entity in the Market, LoB and Functions to ensure their service needs are met
* Manage internal customer experience, analysing root causes of dissatisfaction and/or SLA breaches, and putting in place actions to address these
* Contribute to building internal staff knowledge and awareness of ESG/Sustainable operations approaches and achievements and how lessons could be leveraged across the stakeholder ecosystem.
* Manage all 3rd party service providers and associated contractors for the entity in the Market under Real Estate Services
* Drive Property Management performance of the Assets, working closely with building managers and / or FM teams (both internally and externally).
* Manage and deliver an annualised P\&L for each asset. Including, but not limited to capital investments, life cycle plans, 3rd party leasing interface, technology roll\-out based on HSBC’s strategic vision.

 **Risk Management and Controls*** Continually reassess the operational risks and controls associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of new technology
* Ensure all actions are aligned with HSBC’s ‘3 Lines of Defence’ principles and processes
* Recognising and capitalising on opportunities for global consistency and the highest global standards
 **Leadership \& Teamwork**
* Leadership:
	+ Direct responsibility for Real Estate Services Entity team
	+ Direct ownership of Entity core delivery targets; ensure delivery of commitments
	+ Contribute to the overall GCOO Strategy to drive increased value to the business and customers
	+ Drive change utilising developed golden sources of tools, data and technology to ensure opportunities for efficiencies and consistent reporting.
	+ Be a genuine team player, proactively and positively working for the broader success of the team
	+ Positively and Proactively guide, influence and educate colleagues on Future of Work
	+ Demonstrate leadership behaviours with senior stakeholders and the business
	+ Demonstrate teamwork behaviours with outsource partners and other third parties
	+ Demonstrate strong self\-management/lead by example – healthy lifestyle and habits aligned with the ESG/Sustainable Operations and Wellness agendas of the organisation
	+ Be bold and agile in Ways of Working

  

* Team Management:
	+ Manage the headcount for the entity in the market (including outsourced service provision) and lead people agenda, including talent management, establishing organizational structure to support performance delivery
	+ Implement Group performance management \& reward strategies to balance growth of a sustainable business with allocation of reward aligned to responsible risk management
	+ Implement a business partnering approach to ensure a close understanding of individual business requirements, providing strategies that align to overall Regional / Group Real Estate Services objectives, solutions and services.
	+ Continually work on improving the level of automation and customer ‘end to end’ experience by working closely with Global/Regional RES and HR, IT and outsourced partners who can deliver the new Ways of Working
	+ Build strong vendor governance and engagement to ensure that the delivery through key vendors and contractors are seamless and compliant to HSBC standards and contract obligations

title: Assistant Manager Business Integrity and compliance
description:
**Role:** Assistant Manager – Business Integrity  

**Location:** Mumbai, India

**About Unilever**


Be part of one of the world’s largest consumer goods companies. We are driven by our purpose to make sustainable living commonplace. We are present in 190 countries, have 400\+ brands and 13 brands with turnover of over €1 bn. Every day, 2\.5 bn people use our products every day globally, nine out of ten Indian households use our products daily to feel good, look good and get more out of life – giving us a unique opportunity to build a brighter future.

**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**


The Assistant Manager – Business Integrity is a key member of HUL’s Business Integrity (BI) function, supporting the Business Integrity Officer in driving an ethical, compliant and values\-led organisation. The role spans investigations support, policy management, reporting, training and internal communications.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


A. Investigations Support  

* Support end\-to\-end management of integrity investigations, including intake, documentation, fact\-finding coordination and closure.
* Maintain the investigations tracker; ensure timeliness, quality and confidentiality of records.
* Liaise with cross\-functional stakeholders (HR, Legal, Finance, Supply Chain) to facilitate efficient case resolution.
* Assist in preparing investigation reports and management summaries for leadership review.
* Monitor implementation of remediation actions arising from concluded investigations.

B. Policy Management  

* Support the periodic review, update and communication of BI\-related policies, including the Code of Business Principles and supporting standards.
* Manage the policy lifecycle – drafting, consultation, approval, publication and version control.
* Monitor compliance with mandatory requirements and escalate gaps.

C. Reporting \& Analytics  

* Prepare periodic BI dashboards and reports for the Business Integrity Officer, senior leadership and Unilever global teams.
* Maintain and analyse data on speak\-up reports, investigation outcomes, training completion and policy attestations.
* Support preparation of Board/Audit Committee submissions relating to Business Integrity.
* Identify trends and insights to inform the BI function’s annual priorities.

D. Training \& Capability Building  

* Design and deliver BI training programmes – e\-learning modules, workshops, manager briefings – across business functions.
* Manage the annual BI training calendar and track completion against targets.
* Develop customised training content for high\-risk functions.
* Act as a point of contact for employee queries on integrity and ethics matters.

E. Communications  

* Plan and execute the BI communications calendar – newsletters, Speak Up awareness campaigns, Ethics Day, leadership messages.
* Draft internal communications in clear, engaging language for diverse employee audiences.
* Coordinate with HR and Corporate Communications to amplify BI messaging across channels.
* Maintain and update the BI intranet pages and resource library.
**CANDIDATE PROFILE**


Qualifications \& Experience  

* LLB / LLM from a reputed institution; additional qualifications in compliance, ethics or management are a plus.
* 5–8 years of experience in compliance, business integrity, legal or risk functions – preferably in an MNC.
* Prior exposure to investigation processes or regulatory compliance will be an advantage.

Skills \& Competencies  

* Strong analytical and structured thinking with an ability to connect data to actionable insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication – able to distil complex compliance matters for general audiences.
* High degree of integrity, discretion and ability to handle sensitive information.
* Stakeholder management skills; comfortable working across functions and seniority levels.
* Proficient in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); familiarity with case management systems is a plus.
* Self\-starter with strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Our commitment to Equality, Diversity \& Inclusion  

Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life! This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity.  

Additional Information  

Please apply via this portal as e\-mail applications will not be processed. By applying to this role, you are confirming that you have informed your Line Manager and that you are at a point in your career with Unilever where it is appropriate for you to be applying for other positions.  

  

We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a positive, barrier\-free recruitment journey. Should you require additional information or reasonable adjustments to allow you to present your best self during this process, please contact your Talent Partner listed on the role.

description:

**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 The Employee Relations Manager is responsible for fostering a positive work environment by managing employee relations programs, resolving workplace issues, and ensuring compliance with labor laws and company policies. This role serves as a trusted advisor to management and employees, promoting fairness, consistency, and engagement across the organization strengthening the compliance culture.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.
   

  

**The Employee Relations Manager Has The Following Responsibilities**
* Investigate and lead the people\-related issues such as: behavior/conduct concerns, corrective actions for policy violations, employee grievances, and workplace conflicts in a timely and confidential manner.
* Liaise with labor offices and regulatory authorities to ensure compliance with statutory requirements and manage audits or inspections.

* Partner with HRBPs to address complex employee relations cases, provide strategic solutions, embed compliance and ethical practices into organizational culture.
* Collaborate with global and regional Compliance, Ethics, and Legal teams to ensure alignment with corporate standards and regulatory frameworks.

* Anchor / support the compliance awareness sessions \& training on policies, risk management practices, and other emerging or specific issues to promote consistent understanding across teams.


**Who is USP Looking For?**
 The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
   

  

* Masters Degree/Post Graduate Diploma/Masters in Social Work (Full\-Time) in Human Resource Management.
* 8\+ years of experience in employee relations.
* Strong knowledge in Indian Labour laws and compliance requirements
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills .
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving abilities .

**Additional Desired Preferences**
* Degree in Law is preferred.

 Nil

 USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.

title: HR Data Security Lead
description:
Date live: 07/08/2026


Business Area: HR


Area of Expertise: Technology


Contract: Permanent


Reference Code: JR\-0000119002


  
Join Barclays as an HR Data Security Lead, responsible for designing, governing and assuring the security frameworks and controls that enable the trusted, secure and appropriate use of colleague data across the organisation.


This role will provide leadership across HR data security, access governance, data sharing, privacy\-by\-design controls and security assurance for HR systems, analytics, reporting and AI enabled use cases.


**Purpose of the role**


The HR Data Security Lead will be accountable for ensuring colleague data is protected, classified, accessed and used in line with applicable data security, privacy and information management standards. The role will establish guardrails that ensure data is accessed on a role\-based, purpose\-bound, time\-bound and least\-privilege basis, with appropriate oversight, evidence and remediation where required.


**Key accountabilities**


* Own and govern the security approach for colleague data across HR systems, reporting, analytics and AI enabled use cases.
* Partner with Data Privacy, Legal, HR Technology, Change, Information Security, Identity and Access Management, Risk and Control, and business process owners to ensure colleague data is used safely, lawfully and for approved business purposes.
* Define and maintain role\-based access principles, ensuring the right people and systems have access to the right data at the right time.
* Review, challenge and approve data access and data sharing requests in line with privacy principles, data classification and the agreed security framework.
* Provide oversight of security role design across the HR system landscape, including Workday, analytics and reporting platforms.
* Support programme and change delivery by ensuring the use of HR data in non\-production environments aligns with data security and privacy standards.
* Establish monitoring and assurance activity, including access reviews, privileged access checks, sensitive report monitoring, exception tracking and remediation oversight.
* Support investigation and response activity for HR data security incidents, ensuring issues are identified, escalated, evidenced and remediated in line with applicable procedures.
* Assess new and novel uses of colleague data, including artificial intelligence use cases, and define the conditions under which data may be used securely and appropriately.

To be successful as a HR Data Security Lead, you should have experience with:


**Basic/ Essential Qualifications:**


* Experience leading data security, access governance or data protection controls in a large, complex data environment, preferably within Human Resources.
* Strong understanding of colleague data, Human Resources processes, data access principles, information classification and data minimisation requirements.
* Knowledge of applicable privacy and data security legislation.
* Ability to assess, challenge and translate data requirements into practical security controls, governance standards and assurance activity.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across technical, legal, privacy, risk, control and business teams.

**Desirable skillsets/ good to have:**


* Knowledge of Workday or similar Human Resources security models.
* Understanding of security design within Microsoft technologies and enterprise data platforms.
* Experience supporting artificial intelligence or automation controls for sensitive data use cases.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with Risk and Control, Change and Transformation as well as job\-specific skillsets.


This role will be based in Chennai or Pune.


**Purpose of the role**


To provide a primary liaison service between the business, technology, and security functions. In order to ensure the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information, and support the mitigation of security risk.


**Accountabilities**


* Collaboration with stakeholders to understand their security requirements in business processes and IT projects, to enhance overall risk management.
* Execution of risk assessments to identify and prioritise potential cybersecurity threats that could impact the banks operations and data and guide the implementation of mitigation strategies and communicate findings to relevant findings to relevant senior stakeholders.
* Collaboration with business units to develop and implement security policies and procedures for the banks operations aligned to the risk management framework.
* Management of the implementation, testing and monitoring of security controls across the banks IT systems to ensure the effectiveness of controls and mitigation of risk.
* Execution of training content and sessions to educate employees, enhance cybersecurity awareness and provide guidance on safe online practices.
* Management of complex cybersecurity incidents by collaborating with IT teams and response experts to effectively resolve cases through analysis, expertise support and project supervision.
* Identification of emerging cybersecurity trends, threats, and new technologies to address potential risks by advocating the adoption of new security solutions.

**Vice President Expectations**


* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
